title: JOB TITLE: Full-Stack Developer (TypeScript / React / Node / Supabase), Part-Time, $10/hr SALARY FIELD: $800/month (20 h
description:
READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING.



This post is direct on purpose. It saves your time and ours. Applications that ignore the instructions at the bottom will not be replied to. And to be upfront about the process: text answers don't get you hired here. A screen-share does. If you're not willing to show your real work, live, on camera, stop reading now.



ABOUT US

1 DASH (
) is a US payments and merchant services company with 20+ years in the industry, serving businesses nationwide. Our stance with our customers is simple: "Running a business is hard. Your payments shouldn't be." The software behind that promise is what you'd be building: a payment and invoicing SaaS, an agent dashboard, a mobile app, and internal analysis tools. Our values are simplicity and transparency, in the product and in how we work. That's also why this post is blunt. Small dev team, zero bureaucracy, and the features you ship get used by real businesses to move real money.



THE STACK (THIS IS WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY WORK IN)

• TypeScript everywhere, strict mode

• Frontend: React 18/19, Next.js 15/16, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod

• Backend: Node 20, Express APIs

• Database: Supabase (Postgres + Auth), Drizzle ORM and Prisma

• Mobile: React Native / Expo with NativeWind and Zustand (nice to have, not required)

• Integrations: payment processor APIs (Valor, Dejavoo), OpenAI, Resend, webhooks

• Testing: Vitest, Playwright, Supertest

• Infra: Vercel, Railway, GitHub Actions, pnpm / Turbo monorepo



You do not need every item on this list. You do need to be genuinely strong in TypeScript, React, Node/Express, and 

SQL/Postgres.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Build features end-to-end: database schema, API endpoint, UI

• Fix bugs without being babysat

• Write typed, Zod-validated code that passes lint, typecheck, and tests before you say "done"

• Work with payment APIs and webhooks. This is fintech, correctness matters more than speed.

• Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) daily. We expect this. We don't care that you use AI, every good dev does now. We care whether you understand what it produces, and we will verify that live.



WHO THIS IS FOR

• Mid to senior level: around 3-5+ years of real, shipped work

• You can take a loosely defined task and come back with a working, tested feature

• You communicate proactively. Blocked means you communicate the same day, not three days later.

• You use AI tools heavily however, you can read, verify, and fix everything they produce. If you cannot explain your own code line-by-line on a call, please do not apply. You will be asked to.



Please DO NOT APPLY IF

• You're an agency or you plan to subcontract the work

• You need step-by-step instructions for every task

• You cannot explain code you've submitted without an AI tool open

• You will not record a Loom video or join a live screen-share call



PAY AND SCHEDULE

• $10 per hour. This is the rate.

• Part-time, around 20 hours per week to start. Can grow into more (and full-time) if you're good.

• Flexible schedule, long-term role.



THE HIRING PROCESS (SO YOU KNOW WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR)

1. Application (instructions below)

2. 15-minute live screen-share call. You'll open your own code from the project in your Loom, and I'll ask you to walk through specific files, explain decisions, and reason through a change on the spot. I'll also show you a small snippet from your codebase and ask what it does and what's wrong with it. No prep needed if the work is actually yours.

Note on the call: AI tools must be closed during it. Not because we're anti-AI (you'll use Claude Code daily here) but because the call tests the one thing AI can't do for you: understanding.



HOW TO APPLY. FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY

Read carefully, because the first instruction is not where you expect it. Somewhere in this paragraph is your first filter: the first line of your application must be the word SHIPIT followed by the name of the database from our stack list above. Applications missing either are deleted unread. If you pasted this post into an AI tool and skimmed its summary, you've probably already failed.

1. Attach your resume, or include a Google Drive link set to "anyone with the link can view". A locked link counts as no resume.

2. Record a Loom video, 3-5 minutes. This is the core of your application. Requirements:

o Introduce yourself briefly on camera (face visible at the start)

o Say today's date and the word from your application's first line out loud

o Walk through ONE project you built. Show the actual code in your editor or the live app. No slideshows, no reading from a script.

o Open the git history or git blame on at least one file and show your commits

o Explain one hard problem you solved AND one design decision you'd make differently today

o Videos showing tutorial projects, cloned repos, or code you can't git-blame to yourself are an instant rejection

3. Answer ALL of the questions below, numbered. Skipped questions = deleted application. Keep answers SHORT, 2-3 sentences each. We can tell the difference between concise-because-you-know and long-because-AI-padded.



QUESTIONS: EXPERIENCE (links over stories, everything you claim should be checkable)

1. Years of professional experience, and the biggest thing you've shipped that is live right now. A link is required: live URL, App Store listing, or public repo. "I can't link anything" needs a one-sentence explanation (NDA, internal tool, etc.) plus the closest verifiable substitute.

2. Rate yourself 1-10 on each (be honest, the live call and test task will verify): TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node/Express, Postgres/SQL, Supabase.

3. One feature you built end-to-end, database to API to UI. Link the live feature, repo, or PR/commit range, and tell me which parts you personally wrote.

4. Have you worked with payments, fintech, or third-party API webhooks? One concrete example with specifics (which processor/API, what you handled).

5. GitHub or portfolio link. If your GitHub is empty, link whatever you HAVE built instead.



QUESTIONS: AI WORKFLOW

6. Which AI coding tools do you use daily and for how long? Then in 2-3 sentences: your last real task with one, what it got wrong, and what you fixed manually. (This gets verified on the call, so be accurate, not impressive.)



QUESTIONS: AVAILABILITY

7. How many hours per week are you actually available, and in what timezone?

Generic copy-paste cover letters will be deleted. AI-polished applications might slip past me here, but they do not survive the screen-share, so you're only wasting your own time. Only shortlisted applicants will hear back from us. If you followed everything above, you are already ahead of 90% of applicants.

title: Freelance Video Editor (Premiere Pro), trial project with possible ongoing work
description:
Speck of Dust is a video production company in Sydney, Australia, working across documentary, sport and live-event content.



We are looking for a remote video editor, and we like to start with a single paid trial project so we can both see if it is a good fit. This first project is small (budget around US$150 to US$300). If it goes well, there is real potential for more project work and, in time, a possible ongoing monthly arrangement. To be clear, there is no immediate or permanent commitment up front, and nothing is locked in. We start with this one project, and only if it works would we then talk about an ongoing monthly arrangement.



THE WORK. This first job is a single-camera edit: cutting the best shots into selects and assembling them into a finished piece. Our work overall ranges from emotionally driven, story-led pieces through to fast, energetic sport and event edits.



YOU MUST HAVE (please be honest, this is where we have had trouble before):

- A computer that can genuinely handle large-format Canon C400 footage (.mxf, C-Log2) in Premiere Pro, with a proxy workflow if needed.

- Plenty of fast, free storage. Jobs are often 400GB or more.

- A fast, reliable internet connection. You will be downloading large media and that download time is real.

- Confidence with the Frame.io Transfer app and the Google Drive app, and with relinking media in Premiere.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Premiere Pro, and you hand back the Premiere project file on delivery.

- Organised and reliable, and comfortable communicating day to day on Google Chat or WhatsApp.

- Able to take feedback through Frame.io time-coded notes and action it properly.



A BONUS (not a dealbreaker): After Effects and a sophisticated hand with visual effects.



TO APPLY, please include:

1. Your showreel plus a couple of samples that show range, ideally one story-led emotional edit and one high-energy sport edit.

2. Your computer specs and storage.

3. Your internet speed.

4. Your rate for a single project like this, and your monthly rate if we were ever to move to ongoing work.

5. References and proof of the work and credentials you mention.

A short video call is the next step so we can have a chat.



THE DEAL. We start with this one paid trial project only. If it works, we would love to keep working together on more projects and, down the track, possibly an ongoing monthly arrangement, but nothing is committed or locked in up front. Every editor we engage signs a short agreement: nothing you edit for us is used in their own promotion, and they do not approach our clients directly. This is standard on every job.

description:

We are looking for someone who has real experience generating leads, bookings, or contracts for furnished rentals, corporate housing, short-term rentals, mid-term rentals, insurance housing, relocation housing, hotels, or hospitality businesses.



You should know how to find the right companies, reach the right decision makers, create outreach campaigns, follow up consistently, and help move qualified prospects toward actual bookings or housing agreements.

Corporate travelers

Executives

Relocation clients

Insurance housing guests

Medical travelers

Families needing temporary housing

Event groups

Production crews

Extended-stay guests

High-end leisure travelers

Our goal is to build a reliable direct booking and corporate housing pipeline instead of depending only on Airbnb and other booking platforms.



What We Need



We need someone who can own the outreach process from start to finish.



You will help us identify, contact, follow up with, and convert potential booking sources such as:



Corporate housing managers

Insurance housing / ALE housing contacts

Relocation companies

HR departments

Travel managers

Executive assistants

Hospitals and medical groups

Oil and gas companies

Law firms

Universities

Event planners

Production companies

Sports and entertainment groups

Local businesses with visiting teams, executives, or project-based workers



The goal is to generate qualified conversations that can turn into direct bookings, corporate stays, mid-term rentals, or longer-term furnished housing contracts.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



Building targeted lead lists of companies and decision makers

Finding accurate contact information

Creating
, LinkedIn, and phone outreach campaigns

Writing outreach messages that position the homes properly

Contacting prospects and following up consistently

Tracking every lead, conversation, and follow-up in a CRM or spreadsheet

Booking qualified calls or conversations with interested prospects

Helping move interested leads toward direct bookings or contracts

Coordinating with our team on pricing, availability, and property details

Testing different outreach angles and improving what works

Reporting weekly on outreach activity, replies, leads, calls, and opportunities created



We want someone who can think, execute, follow up, and improve the process without needing to be micromanaged.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a strong fit if you have experience with one or more of the following:



Corporate housing lead generation

Mid-term rental lead generation

Short-term rental direct booking outreach

Furnished rental sales

Relocation housing

Insurance / ALE housing outreach

Hospitality B2B sales

Hotel group sales

Vacation rental direct booking campaigns

Property management lead generation

Executive travel or temporary housing sales



You should understand how to reach decision makers and communicate professionally with companies that can afford premium furnished housing.



Required Skills



You should be strong at:



B2B cold outreach

 outreach

LinkedIn prospecting

Phone follow-up

Lead list building

CRM or spreadsheet tracking

Follow-up discipline

Sales pipeline management

Clear written communication

Booking qualified calls

Understanding premium/luxury positioning

Working independently and moving quickly



Experience with tools like Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Airtable, Google Sheets, Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Clay, or similar tools is a plus.



What Success Looks Like



In the first 30–60 days, we want to see:



A targeted list of corporate, relocation, insurance, medical, and extended-stay prospects

Outreach campaigns actively running

Consistent follow-up with qualified leads

Interested companies entering the pipeline

Qualified calls or booking inquiries generated

Clear weekly reporting on activity and results

Early direct booking or corporate housing opportunities created



The long-term goal is to build a repeatable outreach system that consistently generates direct bookings, corporate housing leads, and furnished rental revenue.



Compensation



Compensation will include a base monthly pay plus performance upside.

title: Google Ads Expert Needed for Luxury STR Direct Booking Campaigns
description:
Summary

We are looking for a highly capable Google Ads expert to help us build, validate, and potentially manage a direct booking campaign system for a luxury furnished rental portfolio in a major U.S. market.



This is not a basic PPC project.



We need someone who understands high-intent Google Search traffic, luxury hospitality, short-term rentals, mid-term rentals, corporate housing, direct booking funnels, GA4/GTM tracking, booking value tracking, negative keyword strategy, landing page alignment, and profitability-based optimization.



The portfolio includes premium furnished townhomes that can be booked individually or together for larger groups.



The properties are positioned for:



Luxury family stays

Group travel

Corporate housing

Executive stays

Project teams

Monthly furnished stays

Relocation housing

Insurance/displacement housing

Medical-related stays

Wedding/event guest lodging

Stadium/event stays

Major international event travelers

Multi-property bookings



We are focused on generating profitable direct bookings, not vanity traffic, cheap clicks, or low-quality leads.



Important context:



Some near-term dates may have discounted dynamic pricing to fill occupancy. Future dates 30+ days out are more valuable because the calendar is optimized for higher nightly rates.



The Google strategy needs to separate:



Near-term vacancy filling with strict profitability controls

Future premium bookings with stronger ADR and higher booking value

Corporate/monthly inquiries

Multi-property group bookings

Event-driven demand

Medical, relocation, and insurance/temporary housing demand



We need someone who can help us build this correctly from day one.



The website and listing links will be shared with shortlisted applicants after the initial proposal so we can evaluate candidates based on relevant experience, strategy, and execution ability first.



What We Need Help With



You will help us create and/or execute a complete Google Ads system, including:



1. Account and tracking audit



Review or help set up:



Google Ads account structure

GA4

Google Tag Manager

Google Ads conversion tracking

Booking value tracking

Form submission tracking

Phone click tracking

 click tracking

Date search tracking

Checkout-start tracking

Booking-complete tracking

Retargeting audiences

UTM structure

Dashboard/reporting structure

2. Campaign buildout



Build or advise on campaigns for:



Brand protection

Luxury group stays

Corporate housing

Executive furnished rentals

Monthly furnished rentals

Multi-property group stays

Location-specific stays

Stadium/event stays

Medical-related stays

Insurance/temporary housing

Major event travel

Near-term availability

Premium future bookings

Retargeting

3. Keyword and negative keyword strategy



We need a very intentional keyword structure.



We do not want broad, cheap, low-quality traffic.



You must be able to separate premium, high-intent searches from low-value searches like budget hotels, apartments, rooms for rent, Section 8, low-income housing, roommates, unfurnished rentals, or job seekers.



4. Landing page and conversion recommendations



You should be able to tell us:



Which campaigns should go to which landing pages

Which new landing pages we need

What CTA each audience should see

Which traffic should go to instant booking

Which traffic should go to quote request forms

How to prevent low-rate bookings from destroying ad profitability

How to position direct booking savings without making the brand feel cheap

5. Profitability and pricing guardrails



You must understand that we are not optimizing only for bookings.



We are optimizing for:



Cost per booking

Booking value

Booking window

Length of stay

ADR

Direct booking percentage

Cost as percentage of booking value

Qualified inquiries

Future bookings 30+ days out

Corporate/monthly leads

Multi-property booking value

Ideal Candidate



You may be a good fit if you have experience with:



Google Ads for hospitality, hotels, vacation rentals, STRs, corporate housing, travel, luxury services, or high-ticket local services

Direct booking campaigns

High-intent Google Search campaigns

GA4 and GTM setup

Conversion tracking and revenue tracking

Booking engine or ecommerce-style conversion tracking

Call tracking

Retargeting

Keyword research

Negative keyword strategy

Landing page conversion optimization

Lead quality scoring

Campaign profitability reporting



You should be able to explain clearly how you would set this up and why.



You Are NOT a Fit If



Please do not apply if:



You only run generic Google Ads campaigns

You optimize mainly for clicks, impressions, or traffic

You cannot set up or troubleshoot GA4/GTM tracking

You do not understand booking value or revenue-based optimization

You cannot explain how to avoid cheap traffic

You rely heavily on broad match without strong controls

You cannot show past results or relevant case studies

You have no experience with hospitality, travel, real estate, direct booking, or high-value lead generation

You need weeks just to understand the project before taking action

You cannot communicate clearly and provide a step-by-step execution plan

First Deliverable



Before we consider ongoing management, we want a short but serious initial audit and action plan.



After we shortlist you, we will send the website, listing links, and additional context.



The first paid deliverable may include:



Initial review of our website and offer

Recommended Google Ads campaign structure

Initial keyword themes

Negative keyword strategy

Tracking requirements before launch

Recommended conversion events

Landing page recommendations

Near-term vs future booking strategy

First 7-day implementation plan

What you would need from us to launch correctly



We already have a detailed internal strategy and campaign direction. Your role is to validate, improve, and execute it with expert judgment.



Expected Working Style



We want someone who is:



Strategic but practical

Fast but careful

Detail-oriented

Data-driven

Clear in communication

Comfortable challenging assumptions

Focused on profitable bookings, not vanity metrics

Able to execute from day one once access is provided



We are open to starting with a paid audit/buildout project, then moving into ongoing optimization if there is a strong fit.



To Apply



Please answer the screening questions carefully. Generic applications will be ignored.



We will only share the website and listing links with applicants who provide thoughtful, relevant answers.

title: ADVICE ASSOCIATE  (URGENT - FINANCIAL ADVICE EXPERIENCE )
description:
ADVICE ASSOCIATE - FINANCIAL ADVICE INDUSTRY (APPLY IF WITH EXPERIENCE)

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Salary: AUD$10-$15ph



ABOUT LIFE UNSHACKLED

LifeUnshackled is a platform built to help people reclaim the life they once dreamed of, clients and team alike. We exist because “retire comfortably” is not the goal, freedom is. We bring bold financial strategy and strong follow-through so clients can build real wealth and live life on their terms. You will be joining a growth-minded team that cares about ambition, high standards, and doing work that genuinely helps people unshackle their lives.



ABOUT THE ROLE

The Associate is the operational and relational lead for their assigned clients, acting as the Chief Operating Officer of each client relationship. This role combines precision in data and document management, project management discipline, people and communication skills, hands-on platform execution, and a delegation mindset. Each Associate is responsible for ensuring timely, compliant, and high-quality delivery of financial advice implementation and client outcomes, in coordination with the broader LifeUnshackled team.



FOUR KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITIES

1. The Information Steward

- Custodian of all essential client information and access rights.

- Curate and maintain a “Client Support Pack” with critical data and supporting documents for rapid use in preparing application forms. This includes identity documents (individuals and entities), FATCA, ABNs, ACNs, TFNs, ESAs, bank accounts, wholesale certificates, etc.

- Collect and store tax-related and performance-related documentation (e.g. holding, distribution, loan, rental, annual, market value, tax statements).

- Maintain and enforce the standard client folder structure, file naming conventions, and financial year categorisation so that files are audit-ready at all times.

- Own the client Fact Find end-to-end — keeping it current after every meeting, statement, or client communication, and ensuring it underpins all advice documents as an auditable chain of evidence.

- Monitor and update the real-time client balance sheet, sourcing data from various platforms and reconciling across systems quarterly.

- Ensure adviser access and login credentials are in place and securely managed across all relevant platforms.

- Collaborate with the PSM to standardise and streamline information management.

- Mindset: “Would I be confident this is clean and client-ready at any time?”



2. The Delivery Project Manager

- Leader of accurate client service implementation and delivery timelines.

- Ensure investment transactions are implemented same-day and insurance applications are begun within 48 hours of approval.

- Turn meeting actions and strategic goals into clearly written, trackable tasks — nothing falls through the cracks.

- Own timelines and deadlines — chasing overdue tasks, flagging bottlenecks, and ensuring every task reaches a clear resolution.

- Delegate technical or administrative tasks appropriately while owning the outcome.

- Coordinate closely with paraplanners, the Practice Support Manager, the Principal Adviser, and external professionals.

- Ensure documents and forms are completed correctly, on time, and sent to the right parties.

- Mindset: “What’s needed to move this forward without needing Principal involvement?”



3. The Relationship Anchor

- Point of continuity, context, and connection for each client.

- Understand the needs and preferences of your clients and orchestrate effective service delivery accordingly.

- Be the primary internal advocate and coordinator for your clients.

- Track developments in the client’s personal and financial life.

- Stay across all meeting notes and ensure task systems reflect meetings.

- Notice changes in goals, mindset, or relationships and raise them with the Principal.

- Support the Principal by ensuring they are well-informed before every meeting.

- Ensure the client never has to repeat themselves or chase us for updates.

- Mindset: “What’s shifted for the client that we haven’t yet actioned?”



4. The Compliant Storyteller

- Ensuring each client file tells a compelling and compliant story.

- Keep client files audit-ready with consistent, clear, and updated notes.

- Manage the full post-meeting workflow: consent and transcription, file note generation and review, follow-up
s, and updating the Fact Find with any new information.

- Ensure fact finds, SOAs, ROAs, and client communications are accurate and well-organised.

- Maintain clarity in the chronology and context of advice decisions.

- Highlight progress and transformation in the client’s journey, tying actions back to their goals.

- Ensure documentation not only meets compliance and privacy standards but tells the narrative of value delivered.

- Mindset: “Would this file make sense to an outsider, showing a clear and compliant story of impact?”



PRIORITISATION ORDER

- From a business perspective, your tasks should be prioritised in the following order:

- Cash / investment transacting, including opening of associated accounts and completion of any KYC / onboarding requirements with third parties where this would delay a cash / investment transaction.

- Insurance applications and getting policies into force.

- Preparing meeting summaries and post-meeting
s for your clients, and any sub-10-minute tasks that are directly requested of you by the Principal Adviser.

- Responding to requests made of us by other professionals (we expect fast responses from them and should return the favour).

- Other work pertaining to clients who are in their first 6 weeks with us (including onboarding).

- Other work pertaining to your broader client list, prioritised by the annual fee that they are paying us and any relationship considerations (including preparing their reports / maintaining their client file with current information / supporting loan applications / etc).

- Balance this priority list with approaching deadlines — as deadlines near, the work becomes a higher priority.

- Anything you can’t get to in a reasonable time, just flag it, and we can try to delegate to others or make a business decision to defer that task.



REPORTING & COLLABORATION

Reports to: Practice Support Manager (PSM) for delivery oversight; Principal Adviser for client outcomes.

Collaborates with: PSM, Paraplanner, Admin Assistant, Principal Adviser.



Indicators of Success

- 100% of clients have complete, current documentation and adviser access.

- Tasks are delivered on time with minimal Principal intervention.

- High service ratings and positive feedback from assigned clients.

- Accurate and timely handoff of technical and administrative work.

- Adviser’s administrative workload is reduced for each client in your portfolio.

- Investment transactions executed same-day; insurance applications commenced within 48 hours.

- Demonstrated proficiency across all required platforms.



Expected Behaviour

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable.

- Thoughtful and detail-oriented.

- Able to prioritise and escalate as needed.

- Collaborative, not siloed.

- Focused on both client satisfaction and internal efficiency.



APPLICATION PROCESS

To apply, please submit the following:

• A 2–5 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you are the best fit for this role

• Your updated CV and LinkedIn profile link

• Names and contact details of three references (2 professional + 1 personal)



Please apply and
 all details to:

mber stays aligned and supported. If you’re the kind of person who naturally takes ownership, thrives in fast-paced environments, and knows how to communicate with clarity and authority, you’ll excel here.



This is a full-time position, requiring consistent availability from 8am to 4pm Eastern Time, with solid internet, power, and backup.



All applicants must complete DISC and IQ assessments before applying.



Detailed Job Description Breakdown



Pod Leadership & Daily Operations

• Lead and manage the daily workflow of closers and setters to ensure the sales pod operates smoothly.

• Run daily huddles, weekly check-ins, and pipeline reviews with clear agendas and follow-through.

• Manage pod-level projects (e.g., SOP rollouts, funnel changes, tracking fixes) end-to-end, ensuring on-time execution.

• Monitor pod performance, identify bottlenecks early, and escalate issues with solutions—not problems.

• Own the onboarding and offboarding process for new sales staff, including systems access, SOP orientation, and performance expectations.

Quality Assurance, Accountability & Compliance

• Hold closers and setters accountable for submitting accurate EODs, updating dispositions, and following SOPs consistently.

• Conduct quality checks on sales calls, calendar availability, CRM hygiene, and follow-up sequences.

• Audit all sales data regularly (bookings, show rates, sales, payments, renewals) to ensure accuracy before reporting.

• Flag performance gaps early and coach tea
mbers with clarity, empathy, and firmness.

• Ensure all pod documentation, scorecards, and checklists are consistently maintained and up to date.



Cross-Department Coordination

• Work directly with Front-End Tech Ops, Back-End Automation Specialists, and Growth Ops to resolve tech issues, data discrepancies, or workflow breakdowns.

• Communicate updates clearly and quickly across all stakeholders — closers, setters, Growth Ops, SOMs, Tech Ops, and leadership.

• Serve as the bridge for multi-team projects (automation fixes, tracking repairs, new funnels, offer migrations).

• Maintain a strong working relationship with salespeople (who may be impatient or stressed under pressure) while keeping communication tight, professional, and steady.



Reporting & Performance Management

• Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports for leadership, ensuring all numbers are accurate and validated.

• Track KPIs across the full funnel: leads ? setters ? calls ? sales ? renewals.

• Support leadership in evaluating pod performance, identifying improvement plans, and implementing corrective action.

• Ensure the sales pod meets revenue, activity, and quality targets consistently.



Skills & Qualifications

• Project Management experience is mandatory.

(Comfortable managing timelines, action items, dependencies, and follow-through across multiple teams.)

• At least 1–2 years experience in sales operations, sales admin, sales coordination, or a similar leadership/ops role.

• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills — able to hold people accountable with firmness and empathy.

• Excellent verbal and written communication; comfortable leading huddles, giving feedback, and jumping on calls.

• Highly organized, detail-driven, and able to manage multiple moving parts in a fast-paced environment.

• Tech-savvy and comfortable navigating CRM, calendar tools, funnels, spreadsheets, and SOPs.

• Experience working with sales teams (closers/setters) is strongly preferred.

• Solution-oriented, proactive, and able to anticipate problems before they happen.

• Thrives in an environment where communication, speed, and ownership are non-negotiable.



If this sounds like you…



If you love driving clarity, supporting high-performance teams, and being the operational heartbeat of a fast-moving sales pod, we’d love to meet you. This role is perfect for someone who wants to grow into higher-level ops leadership while playing a mission-critical role in our sales organization.



About Sales Possible



At Sales Possible, we partner with mission-driven online coaching companies to build world-class marketing and sales ecosystems. We’re not just a sales team provider — we architect full-funnel systems, optimize performance, and support our clients with cutting-edge automation, AI, and operations infrastructure.

We’re a fast-moving, tight-knit team that values ownership, proactive communication, and continuous improvement. If you want to work in an environment obsessed with growth, clarity, and performance — you’ll feel right at home here.

title: TikTok Product Research, Build Shopify Store  and Run Meta Ads Operator | Ecommerce Growth Role**
description:
**TikTok Product Research and Meta Ads Operator | Ecommerce Growth Role**



---



We run a lean ecommerce operation. The model is simple. We find products that are already proven on TikTok Shop, build a Shopify store around them, run Meta ads to scale what converts, and cut everything that does not. We move fast and we reward people who can move fast with us.



We are not looking for someone to manage tasks. We are looking for someone who can find a winning product, build a store around it, launch ads, and tell us what the numbers are saying. If that sounds like what you already do, keep reading.



---



**What you will actually be doing**



Finding products that are already selling well on TikTok Shop using tools like Kalodata. You are not guessing. You are looking at real data. Volume, engagement, competition, margins. Once you find something worth testing you build a Shopify store around it. Fast. We are talking under 8 hours from zero to live. Then you find the best performing videos for that product, make them better, and use them to run Meta ads. You watch the numbers, cut what is losing, and push harder on what is winning. You handle supplier communication, verify orders, and keep everything organized as we scale.



---



**The kind of person we are looking for**



You have found a winning product before and you can tell us the story. You have run Meta ads from scratch including the Business Manager setup, pixel, ad copy, and creative. You know what a 25x ROAS looks like and you know what killed the campaigns that did not work. You can build a Shopify store from scratch including domain, product page, policies, and shipping in one sitting. You are comfortable editing or repurposing TikTok videos into ad creatives. You use AI tools every single day without being asked. You work independently. You do not need someone checking in on you every hour to stay on track.



---



**You are not the right fit if**



You have never actually launched a paid ad campaign from scratch. You need a team around you to do product research. You are looking for a slow paced admin role. You cannot show us proof of something you tested and what happened.



---



**Tools you should know**



Kalodata for product research. Shopify for store builds. Meta Business Manager for ads. CapCut or any video editor for creatives. ChatGPT or any AI tool for copy, research, and workflow. Triple Whale or any pixel and conversion tracking tool is a strong plus.



---



**How we structure pay**



Base hourly rate plus a percentage of sales you directly generate. If you find winners and scale them your earnings grow with the results. We start with a two week trial so both sides can see if this is a good fit before committing long term.



---



**How to apply**



We want to see proof not promises. Tell us about a product you found, tested, and what happened. Show us a store you built. Share ad results even if they are rough numbers. Tell us your product research process step by step. Tell us which tools you use and why.



If your application is generic we will not respond. If it is specific and shows real experience we will get back to you fast.

title: E-commerce Finance & Accounting Specialist
description:
## Summary



We are looking for a reliable and proactive finance employee to manage the day-to-day financial operations of our e-commerce businesses.



The role includes tracking invoices and payments, managing our accounts-payable Gmail inbox, maintaining QuickBooks, reconciling Wise, PayPal, banks and payment processors, tracking inventory, preparing financial reports, and potentially helping with cash-flow forecasting.



This is not a role for someone who only follows SOPs. We need someone who takes ownership, notices problems, investigates discrepancies, and reports unexpected issues promptly.



## Responsibilities



* Manage the accounts-payable Gmail inbox

* Track vendor and contractor invoices

* Organize invoices using Gmail labels

* Record invoice amounts, currencies, due dates and payment status

* Check for duplicate, incorrect or suspicious invoices

* Prepare payments through Wise, PayPal and bank accounts

* Track scheduled, completed, failed and overdue payments

* Maintain accurate records in QuickBooks

* Reconcile banks, credit cards, Wise, PayPal, Shopify and payment processors

* Track Shopify sales, refunds, chargebacks, fees and payouts

* Track payment-processor reserves, holds and delayed payouts

* Track inventory levels and stock movements

* Reconcile inventory records with Shopify, suppliers and warehouses

* Track purchase orders, supplier deposits and incoming inventory

* Maintain inventory valuation, COGS and landed-cost records

* Track advertising, shipping, fulfilment, software and processing expenses

* Prepare weekly and monthly financial reports

* Report unpaid invoices, upcoming payments and cash requirements

* Assist with cash-flow forecasting, budgeting and financial planning

* Keep financial documents organized for accountants and tax filings



## Reporting



You must promptly report unexpected issues such as:



* Missing or duplicate invoices

* Unusual charges

* Changes to vendor payment details

* Failed or delayed payments

* Missing payouts

* Reconciliation discrepancies

* Processor reserves or account holds

* Inventory shortages

* Unexpected increases in costs

* Suspicious transactions



Your report should explain what happened, the financial impact, what you investigated, and your recommended next step.



## Requirements



* Previous finance, bookkeeping or accounting experience

* E-commerce or DTC experience

* Strong QuickBooks knowledge

* Experience with Wise, PayPal, Shopify and online banking

* Strong spreadsheet skills

* Understanding of inventory, COGS and reconciliations

* Strong attention to detail

* High initiative and independent problem-solving ability

* Clear written English

* Reliable communication and follow-through

* Ability to handle sensitive financial information responsibly



## Security



You may prepare payments, but final payment approval will remain with management.



Any changes to vendor banking information must be independently verified before payment.



## To Apply



Please include:



1. A summary of your e-commerce finance or bookkeeping experience

2. The software and payment platforms you have used

3. Your experience with QuickBooks, inventory and reconciliations

4. An example of a financial discrepancy you identified and resolved

5. Your availability and expected hourly rate

6. Your MBTI type

The right person should be able to help create videos where an AI model/person naturally talks about, holds, uses, demonstrates, reviews, or recommends a product.



We are looking for someone who can move fast, produce daily content, follow a system, communicate clearly, and help us build a serious TikTok Shop affiliate content machine.



Main Responsibilities



You will help with:



Creating realistic AI UGC-style product videos

Using model reference images to keep the same AI person consistent across multiple videos

Creating videos where the AI model naturally holds, uses, applies, demonstrates, or talks about products

Creating strong TikTok hooks, product angles, and CTAs

Using AI tools to generate images, video clips, voiceovers, and realistic product scenes

Editing final videos in CapCut for TikTok-style pacing, captions, retention, and conversion

Producing multiple short-form videos per day

Organizing final videos in Google Drive or shared folders

Helping maintain a content/posting calendar

Uploading or preparing videos for TikTok

Managing or coordinating TikTok Shop product links

Tracking video performance, clicks, sales, commissions, and revenue

Identifying winning products, hooks, and content angles

Helping us d
 what content to create more of based on performance

Potentially helping reach out to brands, sellers, or product partners for collaboration, product seeding, or affiliate opportunities

Tools We Care About



You do not need to know every tool, but you must already be experienced with AI video/content creation and able to learn new tools quickly.



Relevant tools include:



Veo

Sora

Kling

HeyGen

Higgsfield

Nano Banana Pro

ElevenLabs

CapCut

ChatGPT

Claude

Grok

Flux

Seedance

Seedream

TikTok Shop

TikTok Creative Center

Google Sheets

Google Drive



Experience with CapCut, ElevenLabs, and at least 2 to 3 advanced AI video/image tools is strongly preferred.



Product Categories



We are especially interested in TikTok-friendly ecommerce categories such as:



Beauty

Skincare

Wellness

Personal care

Supplements

Lifestyle products

Home products

Gadgets

Fitness products

Fashion accessories



Experience creating content for beauty, skincare, wellness, personal care, supplements, or ecommerce products is a major plus.



You Are a Strong Fit If



You are a strong fit if:



You have created realistic AI UGC product videos before

You understand TikTok hooks, pacing, retention, and native-style content

You can make AI videos look natural and not fake

You can create consistent AI characters/models

You can work with product references and model references

You understand ecommerce product marketing

You can produce content daily

You can follow instructions and improve based on feedback

You are organized and can track work clearly

You are comfortable using Google Sheets for tracking/reporting

You are willing to learn TikTok Shop affiliate operations if you do not already know them

You want a long-term full-time role

Do Not Apply If



Please do not apply if:



You are only a basic video editor

You are only a Canva designer

You are a generic VA with no AI UGC experience

You have never created realistic AI product videos

Your AI videos look fake, stiff, robotic, or obviously generated

You cannot create daily content

You need constant hand-holding

You cannot communicate clearly

You are not comfortable tracking performance or reporting results

You are not willing to learn TikTok Shop affiliate operations

You rely on AI tools but lack creative judgment

TikTok Shop Experience



TikTok Shop experience is strongly preferred, but not required.



If you do not have direct TikTok Shop management experience, that is okay as long as you are highly organized, analytical, coachable, and willing to learn quickly.



Over time, this role may include helping with:



Product links

Affiliate content workflow

Posting strategy

Performance tracking

Commission/revenue reporting

Brand or seller outreach

Trial Period



We will likely start with a paid one-week trial before moving into a full-time arrangement.



During the trial, we may evaluate:



Realism of AI UGC videos

Character/model consistency

Product demonstration quality

Voiceover and lip sync

TikTok-style editing

Speed of delivery

Communication

Ability to follow instructions

Organization and reporting



If the trial goes well, this can become a stable long-term full-time role.



How to Apply



To apply, include the word Purple in your application heading so we know you read the full post.



Please answer these questions directly:



Have you created TikTok Shop affiliate videos before, or videos specifically designed to promote products through TikTok Shop?

Have you managed or helped manage a TikTok Shop account before, including product links, affiliate content, posting strategy, commission tracking, or revenue reporting?

Have you created realistic AI UGC videos where an AI model/person naturally holds, uses, demonstrates, or talks about a product?

Which tools have you used professionally? Please mention your experience with Veo, Sora, Kling, HeyGen, Higgsfield, Nano Banana Pro, ElevenLabs, CapCut, Flux, ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, or similar tools.

Please share 2 to 3 examples of your most realistic AI UGC product videos.

Are you comfortable creating videos using the same recurring AI model/person across multiple product videos so the account feels consistent over time?

Can you consistently produce multiple high-quality short-form AI UGC videos per day?

What product categories have you created content for before?

Are you applying as an individual creator/operator or as part of a team?

If we started with a paid one-week trial, what would you realistically deliver in the first 5 working days?

Are you comfortable helping with TikTok Shop affiliate operations, including posting videos, managing product links, tracking performance, tracking commissions/revenue, and possibly reaching out to brands or sellers?

What is your preferred monthly rate for full-time work?



Applications that do not answer these questions or do not include samples will not be prioritized.



We are looking for someone serious, detail-oriented, creative, fast, and long-term minded.

- Communicates clearly and proactively

title: Logistics Coordinator Freight LTL & FTL
description:
This is a role for committed, focused, independent, consistent, and experienced professionals. Do not apply if you're looking for a gig.



We are a B2B store buildout partner delivering complete retail store projects across Canada and the USA — one point of contact for fixtures, refrigeration, walk-ins, millwork, racking, and kitchen equipment. Every project ships freight to a customer's site on a fixed opening date, and this role owns that freight from quote to delivery.





THE ROLE



You own the freight lifecycle end to end. A shipment need comes in, you gather the full spec, pull rates in a TMS, book the load — mostly LTL — send the BOL to the supplier, schedule the pickup, track the shipment, coordinate delivery, audit the carrier invoice, and handle any claim, then log it all. Day to day, the job is steady coordination with customers and suppliers — confirming what is shipping, when it is ready, and when it needs to land.



Much of the work is orchestration. A single store order often pulls product from several different suppliers, and all of it has to arrive at one location at the same time. You plan and sequence those pickups so the loads converge on the customer's delivery date — matching ready dates, pickup windows, and transit times across multiple suppliers and carriers at once. Getting that timing right, repeatedly, is the core of the role.



For US-bound loads you handle cross-border documentation — commercial invoices, broker coordination, and the customs paperwork that keeps freight from sitting at the border.



The boundaries are clean. You do not set customer pricing and you do not do the accounting — the estimating and accounting team owns markup and invoicing. You own the movement and the cost accuracy. Three rules define the job: nothing ships before payment clears (unless the customer has an account with net terms), every BOL comes back signed the same day as pickup, and every carrier invoice gets audited against the booked rate.



This is pure freight movement — no warehousing, no inventory management, no fulfillment.



This is a full-time role. Carriers, suppliers, customers, and the customs broker are reached during North American business hours, so 9:00 to 5:00 Eastern Time availability, Monday through Friday, is a hard requirement — not a preference.





WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The one trait that separates a strong coordinator from an average one is relentless follow-through. The person who chases the signed BOL the same afternoon, reads every line of a carrier invoice, and never lets a shipment drift. In freight, a loose end becomes a claim — so the job is closing loops before they cost money.



Precision under detail load is table stakes — dimensions, weights, freight class, and accessorials have to be right the first time, because a wrong spec is a wrong quote or a failed delivery. On top of that we need calm coordination when several shipments, suppliers, and carriers are all moving toward the same delivery date — no drama, no dropped threads.



This is a long-term, full-time seat. We are looking for someone reliable, mature, and committed — not someone fitting this between other gigs. 



Warehouse, inventory, fulfillment-only, or parcel-only backgrounds without real commercial freight coordination experience will not be considered.





REQUIREMENTS



1. Three or more years coordinating commercial freight in USA or Canada — primarily LTL — including booking loads, managing BOLs, and dealing with carriers directly. Warehouse, inventory, or parcel-only experience without freight coordination will not be considered.



2. Hands-on experience with a TMS or freight booking platform (Freightcom, project44, FreightPOP, MercuryGate, Descartes, or similar) for rate shopping, booking, and tracking.



3. Cross-border US and Canada freight experience, including commercial invoices, customs broker coordination, and Importer of Record basics. (optional)



4. Carrier-invoice auditing and claims handling — disputing reweighs and reclassifications, and filing damage or shortage claims with proper evidence.



5. Comfortable owning a structured workflow inside coordination tools — a TMS, a project tracker such as Asana, shared inboxes, and spreadsheets — without being chased on status.



6. Strong spoken and written English. You will be on the phone every day with carriers, suppliers, customers, and a customs broker, so clear, confident phone communication is essential — alongside professional written English for BOLs, quotes, and
 coordination.



7. Full-time availability on a 9:00 to 5:00 Eastern Time schedule, Monday through Friday. This is a must, not a preference.



Experience coordinating freight for store fixtures, building materials, foodservice, or commercial equipment is a strong advantage.





HIRING PROCESS



1. Application review — applications without a clear, specific summary of freight coordination experience will not advance.



2. A 15-minute interview, booked online. Concrete answers about real shipments — the lanes, the problems, and how you closed them — work best. May be followed by a second longer interview if needed.



3. Offer to the candidate who passes — a full-time position paid semi-monthly, on the 1st and 16th of each month, in exchange for 9:00 to 5:00 Eastern Time availability, Monday through Friday.





TO APPLY



Submit your application through the form here:







The form covers your freight coordination experience, the platforms you have used, your cross-border background, your availability, and your rate. Applications that do not come through the form will not be reviewed.

title: Operations & Client-Communications Assistant
description:
JOB POST — Operations & Client-Communications Assistant



Part-time to start, growing to full-time · US real estate media + marketing



We run two connected businesses — a real estate media company (photo and video for real estate agents) and a digital marketing agency for local businesses. We're looking for a sharp, reliable assistant to own our inboxes, coordinate our team, and keep our media and content moving. You'll be the person our clients and contractors hear from, and the one who makes sure nothing slips.



This starts part-time and grows into full-time as we scale — so we want someone who wants to grow with us.



What you'll do





Own client and contractor communication across both businesses — clear, warm, professional, using our templates.



Book shoots and calls in our systems (Aryeo for real estate, GoHighLevel for marketing) and keep the calendar straight.



Manage media end to end: download finished work, edit photos in Fotello, run simple AI photo edits from our step-by-step guides (object removal, virtual staging), upload to the right place, and hand footage to our editors.



Move and organize files in Google Drive, 
, Aryeo, and GoHighLevel — everything labeled and in the right folder.



Coordinate our photographer, video editors, and contractors so deadlines are met.

Keep the owner looped and flag anything that needs his decision.





The schedule (fits a normal Philippine day — not a night shift)



The work happens in two blocks during your day:





Main morning block — about 7:00–10:00 AM Philippine time (this is 7:00–10:00 PM US Eastern, the evening before). This is when the day's media comes in and our editors are online — you process it and hand it off.



Short evening block — about 8:00–9:00 PM Philippine time (8:00–9:00 AM US Eastern), roughly 1 hour for quick uploads and deliveries.





That's about 20 hours a week to start, growing to full-time as volume grows. Your midday stays free.



Who we're looking for





Excellent written English — you can write a clear, warm, professional message with no hand-holding.



Detail-obsessed and reliable — you follow a checklist exactly, flag problems early, and never go quiet.



A fast learner — you don't need to know our tools already; you need to learn one from a short video and follow it precisely. (We give you written guides and AI assistants so you can learn fast.)

Comfortable with everyday web tools (Google Drive, web apps).



Bonus, not required: real estate, agency, GoHighLevel, or media-coordination experience.





Tools we'll train you on



Aryeo, Fotello, 
, Google Workspace/Drive, GoHighLevel, Claude, and Higgsfield. All provided — and used only for our business.



A note on trust



Because you'll handle client data and our accounts, we take security seriously. You'll sign a simple confidentiality and security agreement, and the tools we provide are for our business only — never personal use or other clients.



Details





Part-time to start (about 20 hrs/week), growing to full-time.

Pay: $700/month for the part-time hours, increasing as it moves to full-time.

Begins with a short paid trial task before a full offer.





To apply (read carefully)





Start your message with the word "ENGINE" so we know you read this.



In 3–4 sentences, tell us about a time you owned communication or coordination for a business or team.



Attach one example of professional writing you've done (an
, message, or short note).

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Sourcer
description:
ONLINE ARBITRAGE PRODUCT SOURCER – FULL TIME



We are a growing Amazon Online Arbitrage business looking to hire one full-time Product Sourcer for a long-term role with room for growth and advancement. This position begins with a 5-day paid trial period before transitioning into a full-time role.



We are building a long-term operation and are looking for dependable tea
mbers who want to grow with us and eventually step into leadership or management roles.



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



To be considered for this position, applicants must submit a complete application as per requirements highlighted below. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



This is a full-time exclusive position. Applicants currently sourcing for other Amazon sellers or working with multiple OA clients will not be considered.



POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer who can consistently identify profitable products while following company systems and SOPs.



The ideal candidate is dependable, proactive, analytical, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.



All leads are expected to be independently researched, meet our sourcing criteria, and align with company SOPs. We have internal systems in place to maintain sourcing quality and originality.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



• Source 10–15 profitable, in-stock leads per day

 • Maintain a lead approval rate of 75% or higher

 • Conduct high-quality product research using approved sourcing methods

 • Ensure sourced products meet profitability and purchasing standards

 • Follow, maintain, and help improve SOPs

 • Communicate clearly with tea
mbers

 • Maintain consistency in daily workflow and lead submissions



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS



Applicants must have:



• Previous Online Arbitrage sourcing experience

 • Keepa experience

 • SellerAmp/SAS experience

 • Reliable internet connection

 • Ability to work full-time, 40 hours per week

 • Strong communication skills

 • High attention to detail

 • Strong analytical ability



Applicants should have a strong understanding of:



• ROI

 • Profit margins

 • Sales rank

 • Keepa charts

 • Pricing history

 • Buy Box behavior

 • Product competition



Because many of our tea
mbers are located outside the United States, a VPN is required to access and source from U.S.-based retailers. Applicants should already have experience using a VPN while sourcing products.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



To apply, you must complete all requirements listed below.



1. Submit 3 Profitable OA Leads



Please submit 3 profitable OA leads sourced within the last 24 hours.



For each lead, include:

 • Supplier link

 • Amazon US link

 • Buy Cost

 • Sale Price

 • ROI

 • Estimated Monthly Sales



Each lead must meet the following criteria:

 • Minimum 30% ROI

 • Low sales rank

 • In stock and immediately purchasable

 • Keepa chart showing a low probability of dropping below break-even pricing



2. Submit a 3–5 Minute Sourcing Video



Please include a 3–5 minute screen-recorded sourcing video showing:



• How you found the lead

 • Your sourcing method

 • SellerAmp/SAS analysis

 • Keepa analysis

 • Why you believe the lead is profitable/ a good lead



3. Answer the Application Questions



Please answer the following questions in your application:



Have you previously worked as an Online Arbitrage Sourcer?

If so, why did you leave your previous role/client?

What is your preferred sourcing method and why?

What are the first three things you check when evaluating a lead?

Why would you be a strong fit for this opportunity?

Do you have active SellerAmp and Keepa subscriptions?

How many Amazon OA clients have you worked with in the past 12 months?

Are you currently working with any Amazon sellers or e-commerce clients? If yes, please explain.

What was the longest period you worked with a single Amazon seller or e-commerce client?

Why are you interested in this position?



Please also include:

 • Screenshot of your internet speed

 • 20-second voice recording explaining why you would be a good fit for this opportunity



ATTENTION TO DETAIL

To ensure attention to detail, please include the following in your application title:



Favorite Fruit | Years of OA Experience



Example: Apple | 2 Years OA



HIRING PROCESS



Stage 1: Application Review



We will review your application, submitted leads, sourcing video, and required materials.



Stage 2: Interview



Qualified applicants will be invited to an interview.



Stage 3: 5-Day Paid Trial Period



Selected candidates will complete a 5-day paid trial period.



During the paid trial, candidates will be evaluated on:

 • Lead quality

 • Approval rate

 • Communication

 • Consistency

 • Ability to follow SOPs

 • Overall fit within the team



Candidates who successfully complete the trial period may be offered a long-term full-time position.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



• Competitive pay

 • Performance bonuses

 • PTO

 • Paid holidays

 • Long-term growth opportunities within the company



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, and eager to grow within a long-term role.



This is a competitive industry, and we value consistency, accountability, strong communication, and strong sourcing ability.



We are especially interested in candidates who take ownership of their work, ask questions when needed, and are committed to maintaining high sourcing standards.



RELIABILITY EXPECTATIONS



Reliability is extremely important in this role.



Consistent attendance, meeting deadlines, and maintaining communication are key performance expectations.



Frequent unexcused absences, missed workdays, or extended communication gaps will not be tolerated.



COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS



Communication is extremely important, especially during onboarding and training.



During your first few weeks, frequent communication will be expected to ensure you fully understand our sourcing criteria, SOPs, and workflow.



We would rather answer questions early than have mistakes made due to assumptions.



Candidates should be comfortable communicating through WhatsApp and/or 
 and providing regular updates throughout the workday when requested.



CONFIDENTIALITY



All sourcing methods, lead lists, SOPs, systems, business information, and company processes are confidential.



They may not be shared, copied, sold, distributed, or used outside of this position.



By accepting this role, you agree to maintain the confidentiality of all company information and sourcing methods.



Thank you for taking the time to apply. We appreciate your interest and look forward to reviewing your application.

Position Overview



This is a fully remote position focused on identifying qualified U.S. business prospects and booking appointments for our sales team.

Your primary responsibility is not just generating leads—but scheduling meetings with business owners who are interested in improving their marketing, website, lead generation, or online presence.

The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, comfortable communicating with U.S.-based businesses, and driven by performance.





Key Responsibilities



Lead Generation

Research and identify qualified small business prospects throughout the United States.

Build targeted prospect lists using online research, LinkedIn, business directories, Google Maps, and lead databases.

Maintain accurate prospect information within the CRM.





Appointment Setting



Contact prospects through
, LinkedIn, social media, and phone calls.

Engage business owners and decision-makers in conversations about their marketing needs.

Schedule qualified discovery calls and strategy sessions for the Voxlumedia sales team.

Follow up consistently with prospects until an appointment is booked or disqualified.





CRM Management



Update lead records, notes, and communication history.

Track outreach activities and appointment status.

Maintain clean and organized pipeline data.

description:
**Applicants must have a Bachelor’s degree in a medical field. Please do not apply if you do not meet this qualification.**



The Patient Care Coordinator (PCC) is the primary administrative and coordination point of contact for patients. PCCs ensure seamless communication between patients, providers, and clinic operations, enhancing patient experience, operational efficiency, and provider workflow. This role is an evolution of the Healthcare Virtual Assistant (HVA) with increased autonomy, patient-centered focus, and clearly defined responsibilities.



Duties and Responsibilities:

1. Patient Advocacy & Engagement

Respond to all patient communications (portal, Elevate,
) within 4 business hours.

Resolve non-clinical patient concerns or escalate appropriately.

Proactively educate patients on care pathways, including medication refills, lab orders/procedures, and form completion.

Recognize and triage urgent clinical or safety issues following established protocols.



2. Clinical & Provider Coordination

Care Plan Summarization: Generate After Visit Summaries using the live document, outlining discussed care plans, goals, and follow-ups.

Manage provider schedules and patient flow to optimize clinic efficiency.

Draft and prepare documentation: AVS, FMLA, ESA, referrals, treatment letters, prior authorizations.

Ensure chart readiness: all intake forms, labs, and external records are complete prior to appointments.

Serve as intermediary between patients and providers, relaying communications promptly.



3. Administrative Task Management

Send health screeners and virtual meeting links to patients prior to visits.

Initiate and manage prior authorizations, order genetic testing, handle medical records, and coordinate lab/referral orders.

Demonstrate adaptability and flexibility in attending to additional duties assigned by the Lead PCC, including providing coverage for other PCC responsibilities as needed.

Ensure compliance with HIPAA, clinic policies, and ethical standards in all tasks.



4. Operational Excellence & Autonomy

Use standardized communication templates for consistency and compliance.

Track patient requests and unresolved items using workflow tools.

Collaborate with billing, front desk, and leadership for cross-functional patient issues.

PCCs are empowered to own and complete tasks within a clear decision matrix, balancing autonomy with escalation when appropriate.



Qualifications for the Job:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in a healthcare field

1-3 years as Medical Assistant is required

HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act) certified



Preferred Experience:

Previous employment in healthcare administration or similar roles that involved assisting healthcare professionals.

Proficiency in using virtual platforms, electronic health records (EHR) systems, and other healthcare-related software is important.

Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance: Understanding HIPAA regulations and other healthcare compliance requirements is highly desirable.



Equipment Required:

Desktop/Laptop Computer

Internet



Key Competencies:

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally.

Effective time management skills, capable of prioritizing tasks and meeting deadlines consistently.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Exhibit reliability by consistently being punctual for both work and meetings.

Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge of medical terminology and healthcare processes.

Familiarity with platforms such as Cover
ds, GeneSight, and iFax is preferred.

Proven ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.

This position ensures fuel inventory, fuel deliveries, sales, invoices, tank readings, and reconciliation records are entered accurately and timely to support daily operations, inventory control, and financial reporting. * Enter daily fuel invoices and delivery information into the Petrosoft Back Office System.

* Reconcile fuel sales against inventory and delivery records.

* Review fuel variances and investigate discrepancies between sales, deliveries, and inventory counts.

* Maintain accurate records of fuel purchases, transfers, and inventory movements.

* Enter competitor fuel pricing information when required.

* Monitor fuel reconciliation reports and assist with resolving overages, shortages, and inventory variances.

* Verify Bills of Lading (BOLs), fuel delivery documentation, and vendor invoices for accuracy.

* Assist with daily, weekly, and monthly fuel reporting requirements.

* Communicate with store managers, vendors, and operations personnel regarding discrepancies or missing documentation.

* Maintain organized electronic and physical records of fuel transactions.

#### Required Qualifications

* Previous data entry, accounting, bookkeeping, or fuel inventory experience preferred.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and general computer applications.

* Strong mathematical and analytical skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

* Ability to handle confidential business information.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.



#### Preferred Experience



* Convenience store or gas station operations.

* Fuel inventory management and reconciliation.

* Invoice processing and accounts payable support.

* Point-of-sale (POS) and back-office software systems. ([Petrosoft][3])



#### Skills



* Data entry accuracy

* Fuel inventory reconciliation

* Invoice processing

* Inventory management

* Problem-solving

* Reporting and recordkeeping

* Communication and teamwork



#### Physical Requirements



* Ability to sit for extended periods.

#### Performance Metrics



* Accuracy of fuel data entry.

* Timeliness of invoice and fuel reconciliation completion.

* Compliance with company procedures and deadlines.

title: Sales Development Representative (High-Ticket Appointment Setter)
description:
About the role



Tres Client Acquisition Pte Ltd is a business education and advisory company serving founders and business owners across Singapore and Malaysia. We generate a steady flow of inbound leads and buyers, and we're looking for a sharp, experienced Sales Development Representative to own the first conversation, qualify the right people, and get them booked (and showing up) for calls with our closing team.



This is not an entry-level dialling job. You'll be the front line of our sales engine, and the quality of every booked call runs through you.



What you'll do:

- *Inbound speed-to-lead.* Call new inbound leads within 60 seconds of opt-in, qualify them, and book them onto a closer's calendar.

- *Qualify self-booked leads.* Vet people who've already booked a call to confirm they're a genuine fit before they reach a closer.

- *Lift show rates.* Run confirmation and reminder sequences, and recover no-shows and cancellations back onto the calendar.

- *Reactivate the database.* Call and warm up aged leads, re-open the conversation, and set appointments.

- *Recover abandoned carts.* Call people who started but didn't complete a purchase.

- *Drive event attendance.* Call to fill our low-ticket events, and follow up with attendees afterwards to set calls.

- *Work every channel.* Phone and Zoom first, plus WhatsApp, SMS, and
 in a structured multi-touch cadence.

- *Keep the engine clean.* Log every call and outcome in GoHighLevel, and write a clear handoff brief (problem, numbers, goal) for the closer on every booked call.



What we're looking for:

- *2–3+ years in high-ticket sales* — as an appointment setter, SDR, or closer. Experience selling or setting for coaching, consulting, or info-product offers is a strong advantage; experience as a closer is a big plus.

- *Exceptional spoken English.* Fluent, clear, and neutral — your English should sound polished and professional to a Singapore and Southeast Asian business audience, with no strong regional accent. Comfortable with Singapore/British English conventions rather than heavy American slang. (We'll assess this through your application video — see "How to apply.")

- *A real phone and Zoom operator.* Confident on the phone and on camera, calm under objections, and skilled at consultative, question-led conversations. You build trust fast and you don't sound scripted.

- *Disciplined and coachable.* You log your work, hit your activity targets, and act on call-review feedback.

- *Properly set up to work from home.* A quiet, professional environment, a reliable high-speed internet connection with a backup, a good headset, a webcam, and a capable computer.

- *Able to work Singapore business hours (GMT+8)* — which is your timezone, so no night shifts.



Nice to have:

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel (or a similar CRM), a power/auto-dialler, and WhatsApp Business.

- Experience reactivating cold databases or running outbound campaigns.

- A track record you can point to (set rates, show rates, or deals influenced).



What success looks like (first 90 days):

- Consistently dialling inbound leads inside 60 seconds.

- Hitting target connect, set, and show rates on qualified conversations.

- Clean CRM hygiene and closer briefs on every booked call.



Compensation:

- *Base: SGD $800–$1,200/month*, depending on experience.

- *Plus a per-show bonus* for every qualified call that actually attends.

- (Optional, recommended to attract top talent: a small commission on deals closed from the calls you set — this is what turns a good SDR into a motivated one and helps land an ex-closer.)

- Paid in Singapore Dollars, monthly via bank transfer.



How to apply:

We're not interested in a traditional CV. Instead, send us two things:



1. A short presentation (slides or a document) covering:

- What you sold, and who you sold it to.

- Why the offer was good — why people bought.

- The results you helped your customers or clients achieve.

- Your specific role in the sales process.

- The results you brought the company (give real numbers).

- Why you believe your experience will help TRES specifically.



2. A short video selling yourself to us. Treat us as the prospect and convince us you're the right person for this role. This is how we assess your spoken English, your presence, and your ability to actually sell — so make it count.
