title: Appointment Setter
description:
Financial Literacy Basics

FINANCIAL PLANNERS

Position: Appointment Setter / Business Development Representative





Location Remote — Work From Anywhere

Employment Type Independent Contractor (1099)

Daily Activity Standard Minimum 100 dials per day — Target 100–300 with power dialer

Contact Goal 20–30 live prospect conversations per day

Compensation Monthly Retainer + Per Qualified Appointment Bonus

Reports To Lead Financial Planner, Financial Literacy Basics

Start Date Immediate



ABOUT Financial Literacy Basics





Financial Literacy Basics is a financial planning and education firm operating under the financial planning and education brand. We design retirement and wealth plans built to last — plans grounded in structural analysis, real math, and risks most advisors never address. We work with people at every stage of their financial journey who want to make sure their money is working as hard as they are.



We are not a traditional financial advisory/planning firm. We are plan architectural engineers. Our work identifies the gaps, the blind spots, and the structural weaknesses in a client's current approach — and we build the framework to fix them.



THE ROLE





We are looking for motivated, self-directed individuals to join Financial Literacy Basics as Appointment Setters. Your role has two clear objectives: connect with prospective clients by phone, schedule a 20-minute discovery call with our lead planner, and collect basic financial profile data so the architect can make the most of that conversation.



You do not need a financial background. You do not need sales experience. You need confidence on the phone, the discipline to make calls consistently, and the professionalism to represent the Financial Literacy Basics brand with integrity.



This is a door-opening role. You are the first impression and the intake point. Your success is measured by two things: qualified appointments booked and prospect data collected accurately.



RESPONSIBILITIES





• Make outbound cold calls to prospective clients using a provided script and contact list

• Deliver the Financial Literacy Basics opening script with consistency, confidence, and professionalism

• Handle common objections using trained responses and redirect to appointment booking

• Schedule 20-minute discovery calls between prospects and the Financial Literacy Basics lead architect

• Collect basic financial profile data from each booked prospect — years to retirement, investable asset range, advisor status, and primary financial concern

• Submit completed prospect data forms to the lead architect prior to each scheduled call

• Leave professional voi
s and follow up with prospects on callback commitments

• Log all call activity daily — dials, contacts, outcomes, appointments booked, and data collected

• Maintain a minimum of 100 dials per day; target 100–300 using power dialer tools

• Participate in brief weekly check-in calls to review performance and refine approach



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT





This is strictly an appointment-setting and data collection role. You are not expected to discuss financial strategy, investment products, market conditions, or any aspect of retirement planning. If a prospect asks detailed financial questions, your response is: "That's exactly what the call is for — I'll let our lead architect walk you through it."



• You will NOT provide financial advice or discuss investment strategies

• You will NOT present or explain the Financial Literacy Basics plan methodology

• You will NOT represent yourself as a financial advisor or planner

• You will NOT make promises about outcomes, returns, or specific plan recommendations

• You will NOT discuss fees or pricing — that is handled by the lead architect



DATA COLLECTION RESPONSIBILITY





Once a prospect agrees to a call and confirms their
, you will collect four data points before ending the conversation. This takes approximately 60 seconds and is framed as helping the planner prepare — which it does.



Data Point Why It Matters

Years to Retirement Determines planning horizon and urgency — shapes the entire architecture framework

Has a Financial Advisor? Sets context for how the discovery call is framed — additive vs. first-time planning

Investable Asset Range Establishes whether the prospect is qualified and helps architect tailor the conversation

Primary Financial Concern Market risk, income, inflation, or legacy — allows architect to lead with what matters most to them



If a prospect declines to answer, do not push. Note it as "declined" and move on. The appointment is always the priority — data collection is secondary.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR





Required

• Comfortable and confident speaking on the phone with strangers

• Self-motivated — able to work independently without daily supervision

• Disciplined — able to maintain 50+ dials per day consistently

• Detail-oriented — able to accurately capture and submit prospect data after each booking

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional calling environment

• Basic computer skills —
, calendar scheduling, simple spreadsheets or forms

• Professional demeanor and clear verbal communication



Preferred (Not Required)

• Prior experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or phone-based sales

• Background in insurance, annuities, or any financial services outreach

• Experience using a CRM or power dialer platform (CloudTalk, HubSpot, etc.)

• Demonstrated ability to handle rejection and maintain a positive, consistent approach



COMPENSATION STRUCTURE



Trial Period:

Week 1 and 2:  $35 per qualified appointment — no retainer

Week 3 and 4: $40 per qualified appointment — no retainer



Continuous Offer:

Monthly Retainer $1000 – $3000 (based on performance, experience and availability) + $35-$40  per qualified appointment



Per Qualified Appointment Bonus paid per appointment that is confirmed, shows, and includes collected data

Definition of Qualified Prospect confirmed the call, provided contact info, attended the 20-minute discovery call, and basic data was collected prior

Payment Schedule Monthly — net 15 following the close of the calendar month

Classification Independent Contractor — 1099 issued annually



Compensation details are finalized during the offer conversation. High performers who demonstrate consistency, data accuracy, and brand alignment will be considered for advancement with expanded responsibilities and increased earning potential.



GROWTH PATH





Financial Literacy Basics is building a distribution network. This role is the entry point. Strong performers advance through three stages — all based on performance, not time.



1 Appointment Setter Script-driven outreach. Book the call. Collect prospect data. Nothing more.

2 Junior Financial Planner Learn the Financial Literacy Basics language and methodology firsthand.  Learn basic financial planning and budgeting.

3 Senior Financial Planner Present the plan framework to prospects with architect support. Expanded compensation and responsibility.



HOW TO APPLY





Send a brief introduction — no resume required — that answers the following three questions:



• Tell us about a time you had to persuade someone or handle pushback in a conversation.

• What does your current daily schedule look like and how many hours can you commit to this role?

• Have you ever made cold calls or done phone-based outreach? If yes, describe the context.

title: SENIOR MSP ENGINEER  - Microsoft 365 Projects and Service Escalations
description:
============================================================

SENIOR MSP ENGINEER

Microsoft 365 Projects and Service Escalations

============================================================



We're a small MSP based in Colorado. 26 clients, mostly in healthcare, manufacturing, and compliance focused companies who rely on us as their full IT department. Five people on the team. We're growing and we're looking for a senior MSP engineer who can own project execution from scoping through delivery, and who's ready to step in on the tougher escalations when the team needs you.



This is a senior role. It is not helpdesk and it is not entry level. We're looking for someone who can take a project scope, think through the best approach, write a clear project plan, and run with it. Onboard a new client into our full service stack. Configure a Fortinet firewall remotely while a local tech racks the hardware. Harden a Microsoft 365 tenant for a client pursuing SOC 2 compliance. Document everything thoroughly so the next person doesn't have to start from scratch.



Most of your week is project work. A real part of it is spent with the team on the service board, taking the escalations that need an experienced hand and jumping in on tickets where you can help. We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys both. You like the focus and ownership of running a project from scope to delivery, and you also like being part of a team, talking problems through together, and being the person others can lean on when something tricky comes in. If you get satisfaction from variety and from being useful to the people around you, this rhythm will suit you well.



We value first principles thinking and expert troubleshooting. When you hit a situation you haven't seen before, we expect you to research it, reason through it, suggest your approach, and execute once we align. You'll be solving real problems across a diverse client base, and no two weeks look the same.



You'll report to our Service Delivery Manager. As we get to know your work and communication, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility over time.





------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

------------------------------------------------------------



- Project planning and execution. Taking a scope of work, writing a clear plan, and delivering it with minimal oversight. This is the heart of the role.



- Full client onboardings: RMM deployment, M365 tenant baselining, security hardening, service stack tooling, documentation buildout.



- Microsoft 365 security and identity work: conditional access policies, Entra ID configuration, compliance policies, DLP, MFA.



- Remote network and firewall configuration: IP schema design, VLANs, security policies, VPN setup. Fortinet or UniFi experience is ideal.



- Migration projects: tenant to tenant, Google to M365, IMAP, SharePoint, and on premises Active Directory to Entra ID.



- Intune and endpoint management: enrollment, compliance policies, app deployment, Autopilot. Migrating endpoints from RMM only management to Intune managed. Apple Business Manager and MDM experience for macOS environments.



- Automation and scripting. Building and maintaining scripts to streamline internal processes and client environments. You'll also work with AI development tools on internal systems projects.



- Escalations. During Mountain Time hours, picking up the harder service board issues and jumping in on tickets when the team needs an experienced hand.



- Documentation of everything you touch in our internal knowledge base.





------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

------------------------------------------------------------



- Someone genuinely strong on both sides. Deep in Microsoft 365 security and identity, and just as comfortable designing and configuring networks and firewalls. That combination is what makes someone effective across our client base, and it's exactly what we're after.



- A strong project planner. You can take a scope, map out the approach, and write a plan someone else could follow. You execute it, flag blockers, and submit milestones for review without being managed step by step.



- Someone who likes the variety. You enjoy the focus of owning a project, and you also enjoy being part of the team, jumping onto the service board, working through a tricky ticket, and being the person others turn to when they are stuck. For the right person, the mix is the best part of the role.



- First principles thinker. When something breaks or a project takes an unexpected turn, you research, reason through it, and come back with a recommended path forward.



- Self directed. You'll receive a scope of work and we trust you to execute it.





------------------------------------------------------------

REQUIRED

------------------------------------------
to 5 years in an MSP environment. You've managed multiple client tenants at once, worked within a PSA and ticketing system, and you understand the pace and context switching that comes with supporting a diverse client base.



- Deep Microsoft 365 administration and security experience. Not just mailbox management. We mean conditional access, Entra ID, identity governance, compliance policies.



- Real Intune proficiency: enrollment, compliance baselines, app deployment, Autopilot. Comfortable migrating endpoints from RMM only management into Intune managed environments.



- Cybersecurity proficiency. You understand conditional access policy design, security baselines, MFA enforcement, and identity protection. Experience with HIPAA, SOC 2, or other compliance frameworks is important. We serve regulated industries and our clients depend on us to get this right.



- Solid networking fundamentals with hands on firewall configuration experience. Fortinet or UniFi preferred, others considered.



- Migration experience across different scenarios (tenant to tenant, Google Workspace, IMAP, on premises Active Directory to Entra ID).



- Automation and scripting experience. PowerShell, bash, or similar. You look for ways to automate repetitive work in tools like your RMM, PSA, or other platform APIs. Experience with AI coding tools or workflow automation platforms is a strong plus.



- Excellent written and spoken English. You'll be communicating with tea
mbers in the US in Teams throughout the day and occasionally joining client calls.



- Strong documentation habits. If you didn't document it, it didn't happen.



- Present and committed. You work Mountain Time business hours, 8:30 to 5:30, and this is your only job. Once you're well established with us and as the team grows, there may be room to talk about adjusting your hours.



- Microsoft SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator) and MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator), or a genuine willingness to earn them within your first six months. We cover the exam fees and study materials, and holding either already puts you ahead.





------------------------------------------------------------

NICE TO HAVE

------------------------------------------------------------



- Experience with any of our toolstack: NinjaRMM, HaloPSA, Huntress, ImmyBot, CIPP, Hudu.



- Apple Business Manager and MDM experience for macOS endpoint management.



- Fortinet NSE or UniFi certification or equivalent.



- Experience with AI coding tools, workflow automation or building internal tooling. We're an AI forward team and actively building in this space.





------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT WE OFFER

------------------------------------------------------------



- Full time remote work.



- Competitive pay with permanent increases tied to certifications earned.



- Interesting project work across a diverse client base.



- A team that communicates well and trusts you to own your work.





------------------------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

------------------------------------------------------------



We're hiring immediately and will begin interviews within days of posting.



This application has two required steps, and we only move forward applicants who complete both. Please include both to be considered.



STEP 1. Your resume.



STEP 2. A short video, 5 to 8 minutes. Pick one of the prompts below and walk us through your approach, using a real example from your experience where you can. We care most about how you think and how you approach a problem, so talk us through it the way you would in a tea
eting with your peers.



1. A client is moving about 50 people onto Microsoft 365, coming from Google Workspace or another platform. This is a comprehensive move covering files,
, identity, and endpoints. We are most interested in the order you would run it and why. Where do you slot the files into SharePoint, the identity setup in Entra, the endpoints into Intune, and the
 cutover itself, and what makes you put them in that sequence? Point out the gotchas along the way too, the things you have learned to be careful about. If you have run a migration like this, walk us through how you actually approached it.



2. A client needs a firewall configured remotely, Fortinet or UniFi. A local tech will rack it and give you access. Walk us through how you would plan the deployment: IP schema, VLANs, security policies, and what you would document when you are done. What is the part of a remote deployment like this that you are most careful about, and why?



3. You are hardening a Microsoft 365 tenant for a client pursuing SOC 2 compliance. Which conditional access policies do you put in place first, and why in that order? If you have done this for a real client, walk us through how you approached it.



============================================================

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.

We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.

By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.

And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



This is not your typical Senior Financial Analyst role. You’ll work closely with our VP Finance and senior leadership team, helping to drive financial insight and discipline across one of Australia’s fastest growing companies.

You’ll play a key role in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting and business partnering, turning financial data into meaningful insights that support smart commercial decisions.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, ideal for someone who enjoys digging into the numbers, improving processes, and influencing business decisions.



You’ll be responsible for:



-Preparing monthly financial reports, dashboards and P&L analysis, including clear variance commentary

-Owning the budgeting and forecasting processes across multiple entities

-Building and maintaining financial models to support planning and decision-making

-Providing financial insights and analysis to support senior leadership and operational teams

-Partnering with State Leads and department heads to monitor performance and improve margins

-Assisting with reconciliations and financial data accuracy across systems

-Supporting compliance with BAS, PAYGW, FBT and other regulatory requirements

-Assisting with audit preparation and working with external auditors

-Identifying opportunities to improve financial processes and reporting efficiency

-Leading the implementation of automation, AI tools and improved reporting frameworks

-Report to Finance Manager and working closely with senior stakeholders



What will set you apart from other candidates:



-You’re analytical and commercially minded, able to turn data into meaningful insights

-You enjoy solving problems and improving processes

-You’re comfortable working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

-You’re highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities

-You take ownership and initiative, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement

-You’re curious and interested in leveraging technology and automation in finance



What you’ll bring:



-A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

-CPA, CA or CMA qualification (or working towards) highly regarded

-5+ years’ experience in financial analysis, reporting

-Strong experience with financial reporting, forecasting and variance analysis

-Advanced Excel / financial modelling skills

-Experience with Xero or similar accounting systems

-Strong communication skills and the ability to present financial insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders



What’s in it for you?



-This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

You will serve as a utility-level resource — equally comfortable defining a Microsoft 365 security baseline for a 100-seat client as you are troubleshooting a complex Azure hybrid environment or leading a network redesign project. title: Amazon Private Label Product Research, Sourcing and Launch Specialist / Operations Lead
description:
Position: Amazon Private Label Product Research, Sourcing & Launch Specialist / Operations Lead



Type: Part-Time or Full-Time, Remote/Hybrid (Philippines)



Compensation: PHP 30,000 - 60,000 / month full-time equivalent, depending on level, experience, and proven Amazon Private Label capability. Specialist level: PHP 30,000 - 45,000 / month. Lead level: PHP 45,000 - 60,000 / month. Part-time compensation will be prorated based on agreed weekly hours.



Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours or fixed part-time blocks, with flexibility for China supplier and Amazon-related communication.





About Our Company:



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade and e-commerce. We operate in the global market and use ecommerce platforms such as Amazon to develop new brands and products for international customers. Our company values professionalism, data-driven decision-making, ownership, and long-term partnerships. We are building a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.





Role Overview:



We are hiring for this function across two levels: Amazon Private Label Specialist and Amazon Private Label Operations Lead. Both levels support our end-to-end Amazon private label operation, with the final level based on the candidate’s experience, judgment, ownership, and ability to work independently.



This is a hands-on Amazon Private Label role covering the full operation from product research and market analysis through supplier sourcing, product development, listing preparation, launch support, inventory and shipment coordination, Seller Central follow-up, post-launch monitoring, reporting, and ongoing process improvement.



Specialist-level candidates should be able to independently execute Amazon private label product research, supplier sourcing, competitor analysis, review analysis, listing support, launch preparation, and Amazon operations with strong accuracy, clear reporting, and good judgment. The specialist should be comfortable using SOPs and templates, but should not rely on step-by-step supervision for every task.



Lead-level candidates should be able to take ownership of Amazon private label opportunities end-to-end, including product research, sourcing direction, product improvement, supplier evaluation, launch planning, Amazon operations, and post-launch monitoring. The lead should be able to review work critically, guide execution quality, improve SOPs/templates, identify risks early, and make practical business recommendations with less supervision.



Candidates should have hands-on Amazon Private Label experience. General e-commerce, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, or basic Amazon VA experience is helpful only if it includes direct Amazon Private Label work.





Key Responsibilities:



•	Conduct or lead Amazon product research using Helium 10, Keepa, Amazon search, Amazon Seller Central data, and other available Amazon research tools.

•	Evaluate product opportunities using demand, pricing, competition, reviews, profitability, keyword opportunity, launch difficulty, differentiation potential, and operational risk.

•	Prepare clear product recommendations and explain the reasoning in a practical business-focused way.

•	Source and communicate with suppliers through Alibaba, 1688, Global Sources, and other sourcing platforms.

•	Request and compare supplier quotes, MOQ, lead time, sample cost, customization options, packaging options, compliance details, shipping details, and product improvement options.

•	Identify product improvement opportunities through review mining, competitor analysis, listing analysis, market gaps, customer complaints, and supplier capability checks.

•	Support product development by turning market findings, supplier options, and customer feedback into practical product specifications and improvement ideas.

•	Support or guide listing preparation, including keyword research, positioning, title and bullet inputs, image direction, A+ content inputs, competitor listing review, and product positioning.

•	Support launch preparation, including listing readiness, inventory planning, shipment coordination, sample follow-up, launch planning, missing-item follow-up, and blocker resolution.

•	Coordinate with designers, copywriters, PPC specialists, suppliers, prep centers, freight forwarders, or other contractors when needed.

•	Monitor Amazon Seller Central issues such as listing status, account health, suppressed listings, inventory status, customer feedback, returns, and operational risks.

•	Monitor post-launch performance, including sales, keyword movement, conversion signals, customer reviews, returns, stock level, pricing, PPC coordination, and competitor activity.

•	Prepare clear management updates with risks, blockers, recommended decisions, next actions, and execution priorities.

•	Keep Google Drive, Google Sheets, supplier records, product files, operation trackers, and Amazon operation documents organized and updated.

•	Flag weak assumptions, supplier risks, launch risks, listing risks, inventory risks, Amazon account concerns, or execution issues early.

•	For Lead-level candidates: review junior/support work, improve SOPs, templates, checklists, trackers, and help raise execution quality over time.





Qualifications:



•	Specialist level: 2-4+ years of direct Amazon Private Label experience preferred.

•	Lead level: 5-8+ years of direct Amazon Private Label experience preferred.

•	General Amazon FBA experience alone is not enough unless it includes hands-on Private Label work.

•	Experience with Amazon product research, supplier sourcing, product development, listing preparation, launch support, post-launch monitoring, and Amazon operations support.

•	Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, Helium 10, Keepa, Alibaba, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and structured research templates.

•	Strong understanding of Amazon product research, keyword research, competitor analysis, review analysis, pricing, profitability, launch difficulty, and product differentiation.

•	Strong supplier communication and follow-up skills, especially with China-based suppliers.

•	Strong written English communication and clear reporting ability.

•	Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple product opportunities at different stages.

•	Comfortable following SOPs while also using judgment when a business decision requires practical thinking.

•	Comfortable using AI tools to improve research quality, analysis, judgment, workflow speed, and communication while verifying information carefully.

•	Able to work independently and provide clear updates, risks, decisions needed, and next steps.

•	Comfortable with both pre-launch and post-launch Amazon Private Label operations.





KPIs / Success Measures:



•	Quality and accuracy of Amazon product research, supplier sourcing, listing preparation, launch support, and operation files.

•	Quality of product opportunity judgment and ability to separate weak products from realistic launch candidates.

•	Accuracy of market data, competitor analysis, keyword research, review analysis, profitability assumptions, and launch planning inputs.

•	Quality of supplier outreach, quote comparison, product improvement requests, sample coordination, and supplier follow-up.

•	Ability to identify risks early before they affect product selection, supplier selection, launch timing, listing quality, inventory availability, or account performance.

•	Clear communication of blockers, risks, next steps, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions.

•	Low error rate in data entry, supplier details, Amazon listing details, cost assumptions, and research reports.

•	Reliable ownership across product research, sourcing, product development, launch preparation, Seller Central follow-up, and post-launch monitoring.

•	For Lead-level candidates: ability to improve execution quality, guide junior/support work, and improve SOPs, templates, or trackers when needed.

•	Consistent ability to follow company instructions, SOPs, policies, and communication standards while also applying sound judgment.





What We Offer:



•	Part-time or full-time remote work opportunity with a Canadian company.

•	Opportunity to work across the full Amazon private label process from product research to post-launch operations.

•	Long-term opportunity as the Amazon private label business grows.

•	Structured SOPs, templates, and process support.

•	Direct communication with company management.

•	Opportunity to grow into higher ownership based on proven capability and results.

•	Performance-based growth opportunities based on ownership, reliability, and execution quality.





Application Instructions:



To apply, please include the phrase "Amazon PL Role" in the first line of your application and answer the following questions briefly:

1.	Are you applying for Specialist level, Lead level, or open to either level based on assessment?

2.	Are you applying for full-time or part-time work? If part-time, how many hours per week can you consistently commit?

3.	How many years of direct Amazon Private Label experience do you have?

4.	Which Amazon tools have you used directly? Please mention Helium 10, Keepa, Seller Central, Alibaba, or others if applicable.

5.	Describe one private label product you helped identify, source, launch, improve, or scale. Please mention your exact role in the process.

6.	What makes a product a poor private label launch candidate, even if the sales look strong?

7.	Are you comfortable completing a practical Amazon PL assessment before final hiring?

title: B2B Outbound Caller
description:
NOVA Signage is a leading provider of custom signage manufacturing solutions for sign shops, print shops, distributors, and trade buyers across North America. Our website serves as a B2B member login portal where we offer custom signage products, wholesale partner pricing, quote support, and production services designed to help our clients sell more signage products without expanding their own manufacturing capacity.



We are looking for a reliable B2B Outbound Caller / Lead Qualification Specialist to join our team. This is a remote, part-time position based in the Philippines, starting at 20 hours/week, with the potential to increase hours based on performance.

The cold callers should know how to professionally navigate gatekeepers, identify decision-makers, collect accurate details, and make meaningful business-to-business calls.



This is not a hard-selling role. Your main responsibility is to call sign shops and printing shops in North America, identify the right contact person, collect accurate information, and confirm whether they are interested in receiving a NOVA trade sample kit. Our internal sales team will handle qualified leads and follow-up conversations.



Responsibilities

Follow a simple calling script and qualification process.

Handle gatekeepers professionally and politely.

Update lead status after every call, such as wrong number, not qualified, decision maker found,
 collected, sample kit approved, follow-up needed, or not interested.

Escalate interested prospects to the NOVA sales team for follow-up.

Maintain a professional, calm, and friendly tone on all calls.



Qualifications

3+ years of experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, lead generation, or B2B prospecting.

Experience calling businesses in the United States or Canada.

Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, and professional accent.

Strong listening skills and attention to detail.

Basic computer skills, including Google Sheets, CRM systems,
, and online phone platforms.

title: Bookkeeper/ Financial Advisor
description:
I’m seeking a detail-oriented, proactive Financial Advisor / Bookkeeper to support both my business and personal finances. This role is for someone who doesn’t just track numbers—but helps me understand them, plan with them, and make better decisions because of them.



I need someone who is confident in their work, good at what they do, and able to explain finances clearly, calmly, and without jargon.



This is a collaborative role with frequent meetings (weekly or bi-weekly). I’m looking for someone who takes initiative, flags issues before they become problems, and actively brings insights to the table.





I’m a business owner and I need a financial advisor who will help me answer questions like:



How much should I be saving monthly to reach my goals?



How much should I be paying down on my credit cards?



What should my monthly credit card budget be?



Am I overspending in certain categories?



Can I afford travel right now?



How much can I reasonably spend on eating out or coffee?



How many hours should my employees be working?



Does it make financial sense to hire someone new?

title: Contracts and Client Accounts Officer
description:
Position Description

Contracts & Client Accounts Officer

Employment Type



Full-Time



Reports To



Operations Manager / Practice Manager



Position Summary



The Contracts & Client Accounts Officer is responsible for managing the contractual and financial administration of client matters from engagement through to completion. The role prepares service agreements and contract variations based on consultation outcomes and instructions provided by Registered Migration Agents (RMAs), maintains client accounts, generates invoices, monitors payments, negotiates payment arrangements, follows up outstanding accounts, reconciles client records, and issues Statements of Service upon completion of contracted services.



The position plays a critical role in ensuring contractual accuracy, timely billing, effective debt collection, accurate client account management, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements while maintaining positive client relationships.



Key Duties and Responsibilities



1. Contract Preparation and Administration

Prepare service agreements based on consultation outcomes and instructions provided by RMAs.

Draft contract variations, amendments, and additional service agreements as directed by RMAs.

Ensure agreements accurately reflect the approved scope of services, fees, payment schedules, and terms and conditions.

Issue agreements to clients and manage contract execution processes.

Explain agreement terms, payment obligations, and contract variations to clients where required.

Maintain contract registers and document management systems.

Store executed agreements and related documents within the client management system.

Monitor contract status and ensure documentation remains complete and current.

Maintain standard agreement templates and supporting documentation.



2. Client Account Management

Establish and maintain client accounts upon engagement.

Record agreements, variations, invoices, payments, credits, refunds, and account adjustments.

Monitor client account balances and payment schedules.

Maintain accurate client financial records and transaction histories.

Reconcile client accounts and investigate discrepancies.

Prepare client account statements and payment summaries when required.

Respond to client enquiries regarding invoices, payments, balances, and contractual charges.

Ensure all client account information is accurate, complete, and up to date.



3. Invoicing and Revenue Administration

Generate invoices in accordance with approved agreements and contract variations.

Prepare milestone, progress, and final invoices.

Verify invoice accuracy prior to issue.

Ensure fees charged align with contractual obligations and approved services.

Maintain invoice registers and billing records.

Monitor upcoming billing events and payment schedules.

Coordinate with RMAs regarding additional billable services and approved variations.

Ensure timely invoicing of all contracted services.



4. Accounts Receivable, Collections and Negotiations

Monitor outstanding invoices and payment due dates.

Follow up overdue accounts via telephone,
, and written correspondence.

Issue payment reminders, demand notices, and account statements.

Negotiate payment arrangements and payment plans within approved authority limits.

Resolve account disputes and billing queries professionally and efficiently.

Encourage timely payment while maintaining positive client relationships.

Maintain records of collection activities and client communications.

Monitor compliance with agreed payment arrangements.

Escalate unresolved accounts to management when required.

Assist with debt recovery activities where necessary.

Prepare aged debtor and accounts receivable reports.

Work proactively to minimise overdue accounts and improve collection performance.



5. Service Delivery Tracking

Monitor client matters against contracted services, milestones, and deliverables.

Liaise with RMAs and support staff regarding service progress and completion.

Track approved contract variations and associated billing events.

Ensure services delivered align with contractual obligations.

Identify and report discrepancies between contracted and delivered services.



6. Service Completion and Matter Closure

Liaise with RMAs to verify completion of contracted services.

Prepare and issue Statements of Service upon completion of services.

Ensure all invoices have been issued prior to matter closure.

Reconcile client accounts before file closure.

Issue final account statements where required.

Ensure all contractual and financial records are complete and properly filed.

Close client matters in accordance with company procedures.



7. Reporting and Record Keeping

Maintain accurate records of contracts, variations, invoices, payments, collections, negotiations, and client accounts.

Prepare weekly and monthly operational and financial reports.

Monitor contract activity, revenue generation, outstanding accounts, collection performance, and payment plan compliance.

Support management with reporting and business analysis.

Maintain audit-ready documentation and records.



8. Compliance and Quality Assurance

Ensure all documentation complies with company policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Maintain confidentiality of client information.

Support internal audits and compliance reviews.

Identify process improvement opportunities and contribute to operational efficiency.

Maintain high standards of accuracy and professionalism in all documentation and communications.



Essential Qualifications

Diploma, or equivalent qualification in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Legal Services, Contract Administration, or a related discipline; or

Equivalent demonstrated work experience.



Essential Experience

Minimum 2 years' experience in:

Contract Administration;

Client Account Management;

Accounts Receivable;

Finance Administration; or

Professional Services Administration.

Demonstrated experience:

Preparing contracts, agreements, and variations.

Managing client accounts and records.

Generating invoices and administering billing processes.

Following up outstanding accounts and collecting payments.

Negotiating payment arrangements and resolving account-related issues.

Maintaining accurate financial and administrative records.

Working with CRM and business management systems.

Managing client-facing financial discussions.

Experience within a migration, legal, accounting, consulting, education, or other professional services environment.

Experience using QuickBooks Online.

Experience using CRM or practice management systems.

Experience supporting compliance-driven service delivery environments.



Essential Skills



Contract Administration

Ability to prepare contracts, agreements, and variations from approved templates and instructions.

Strong document management and record-keeping skills.

Ability to interpret instructions and accurately translate them into contractual documentation.



Financial Administration

Invoice generation and billing administration.

Accounts receivable management.

Payment allocation and reconciliation.

Debt collection and account follow-up.

Client account management and reporting.



Negotiation and Relationship Management

Strong negotiation skills.

Ability to negotiate payment arrangements and collection outcomes.

Ability to manage difficult conversations professionally.

Ability to resolve disputes and account-related issues.

Ability to influence positive outcomes while maintaining client relationships.

Strong stakeholder management skills.



Technical Skills

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams.

Ability to work with CRM, accounting, and practice management systems.

Experience with QuickBooks Online will be highly regarded.

Strong data entry accuracy and database management skills.



Communication Skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Professional client service skills.

Ability to communicate contractual, financial, and account-related matters clearly and professionally.

Ability to build rapport and maintain productive client relationships.



Organisational Skills

Strong attention to detail.

Excellent time management and prioritisation skills.

Ability to manage multiple client matters simultaneously.

Ability to work independently while meeting deadlines.



Personal Attributes

Highly organised and detail-oriented.

Professional and client-focused.

Honest, trustworthy, and able to maintain confidentiality.

Strong sense of accountability and ownership.

Process-driven and committed to accuracy.

Proactive and solutions-oriented.

Confident and professional communicator.

Tactful and diplomatic when handling sensitive financial matters.

Resilient and comfortable dealing with difficult conversations.

Able to negotiate effectively while maintaining professionalism and client satisfaction.

Able to work effectively in a team environment.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Service agreements prepared within 24 hours of receiving RMA instructions.

Contract variations prepared within 24 hours of approval.

Invoice accuracy rate of 99% or higher.

All invoices issued within 1 business day of becoming billable.

Reduction in aged debtors and overdue accounts.

Collection targets achieved each month.

Payment plans monitored and maintained effectively.

Accurate maintenance of client account records.

Statements of Service issued within 2 business days of service completion.

Compliance with company policies and quality standards.

Audit-ready client files and financial records at all times.





Ideal Candidate



A highly organised and commercially minded professional with experience in contract administration, client account management, invoicing, collections, and financial administration. The ideal candidate possesses strong negotiation skills, is confident managing client financial discussions, and can independently manage the contractual and financial lifecycle of client matters while supporting RMAs and ensuring a professional client experience. Experience with QuickBooks Online, CRM systems, and professional services environments will be highly regarded.

title: Lead Generation Expert/Appointment Setter
description:
Summary

We are looking for an experienced Corporate Housing / Direct Booking Outreach Expert to help us generate direct bookings, mid-term stays, corporate housing opportunities, insurance housing leads, relocation stays, and furnished housing contracts for a luxury rental portfolio in Houston, Texas.



This is not a generic VA role.

This is not just a basic appointment-setting role.

This is not for someone who has only done Airbnb guest support.



We are looking for someone who has real experience generating leads, bookings, or contracts for furnished rentals, corporate housing, short-term rentals, mid-term rentals, insurance housing, relocation housing, hotels, or hospitality businesses.



You should know how to find the right companies, reach the right decision makers, create outreach campaigns, follow up consistently, and help move qualified prospects toward actual bookings or housing agreements.



About the Properties



We operate Thompson Luxury Properties, a collection of 4 luxury furnished homes located in Houston, TX 77007.



The homes are fully furnished, professionally designed, and ideal for:



Corporate travelers

Executives

Relocation clients

Insurance housing guests

Medical travelers

Families needing temporary housing

Event groups

Production crews

Extended-stay guests

High-end leisure travelers



The properties are located near major Houston demand drivers, including Downtown Houston, The Heights, Rice Military, Memorial Park, the Galleria, Texas Medical Center, NRG Stadium, universities, law firms, oil and gas companies, medical centers, and corporate offices.



Our goal is to build a reliable direct booking and corporate housing pipeline instead of depending only on Airbnb and other booking platforms.



What We Need



We need someone who can own the outreach process from start to finish.



You will help us identify, contact, follow up with, and convert potential booking sources such as:



Corporate housing managers

Insurance housing / ALE housing contacts

Relocation companies

HR departments

Travel managers

Executive assistants

Hospitals and medical groups

Oil and gas companies

Law firms

Universities

Event planners

Production companies

Sports and entertainment groups

Local businesses with visiting teams, executives, or project-based workers



The goal is to generate qualified conversations that can turn into direct bookings, corporate stays, mid-term rentals, or longer-term furnished housing contracts.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



Building targeted lead lists of companies and decision makers

Finding accurate contact information

Creating
, LinkedIn, and phone outreach campaigns

Writing outreach messages that position the homes properly

Contacting prospects and following up consistently

Tracking every lead, conversation, and follow-up in a CRM or spreadsheet

Booking qualified calls or conversations with interested prospects

Helping move interested leads toward direct bookings or contracts

Coordinating with our team on pricing, availability, and property details

Testing different outreach angles and improving what works

Reporting weekly on outreach activity, replies, leads, calls, and opportunities created



We want someone who can think, execute, follow up, and improve the process without needing to be micromanaged.



Ideal Candidate



You may be a strong fit if you have experience with one or more of the following:



Corporate housing lead generation

Mid-term rental lead generation

Short-term rental direct booking outreach

Furnished rental sales

Relocation housing

Insurance / ALE housing outreach

Hospitality B2B sales

Hotel group sales

Vacation rental direct booking campaigns

Property management lead generation

Executive travel or temporary housing sales



You should understand how to reach decision makers and communicate professionally with companies that can afford premium furnished housing.



Required Skills



You should be strong at:



B2B cold outreach

 outreach

LinkedIn prospecting

Phone follow-up

Lead list building

CRM or spreadsheet tracking

Follow-up discipline

Sales pipeline management

Clear written communication

Booking qualified calls

Understanding premium/luxury positioning

Working independently and moving quickly



Experience with tools like Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Airtable, Google Sheets, Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Clay, or similar tools is a plus.



What Success Looks Like



In the first 30–60 days, we want to see:



A targeted list of corporate, relocation, insurance, medical, and extended-stay prospects

Outreach campaigns actively running

Consistent follow-up with qualified leads

Interested companies entering the pipeline

Qualified calls or booking inquiries generated

Clear weekly reporting on activity and results

Early direct booking or corporate housing opportunities created



The long-term goal is to build a repeatable outreach system that consistently generates direct bookings, corporate housing leads, and furnished rental revenue.



Compensation



Compensation will include a base monthly pay plus performance upside.



We are open to discussing the right structure with the right candidate, but the goal is to create a win-win arrangement where you are rewarded for actual results.



Performance upside may be tied to:



Direct bookings generated

Corporate housing contracts secured

Extended-stay bookings

Qualified opportunities created

Revenue generated from your outreach



We are looking for someone who wants to be invested in the outcome, not just paid for activity.



There is long-term upside for the right person if results are achieved.

title: COO/Management Residential Appraisal Report Writer
description:
We are a successful residential appraisal firm located in the Bay Area, California. We employ over 10 on the team and are looking for a very senior level experienced residential appraisal report writer to lead our team.



The team includes 3 Bay Area appraisers and 8 employees in the Philippines. We are rapidly growing and are looking for someone with experience completing the entire residential appraisal report, including commentary, who ideally has experience with managing and leading other appraisal report writers. Your role will effectively be acting as chief operating officer of our company while also being directly involved in reports.



Your role and responsibilities include the following:

1. Ensuring every report is completed to our standards. Either directly or through the processes and procedures you develop, it will be your responsibility to ensure that each and every report created by our report writers is free from errors and submission-ready. While this will start by having you directly review each report written by our team before submission, we are in the process of also hiring quality assurance reviewers, who you will lead and manage.

2. Training and managing residential report writers. It will be your responsibility to ensure that all report writers on our tea
et the criteria and standards in place to ensure high quality reports.

3. Acting as the liaison between leadership and the report writing staff. If there is too much work for the team, you will be in charge of letting leadership know so that additional tea
mbers can be hired. Or if there are any other issues, you will be in charge of resolving them or bringing it to leadership's attention.

4. Acting as the closer. Ultimately, everything on the report writing side will fall under your responsibility. We are looking for someone who is proactive at solving problems without getting the leadership team involved, however we are of course readily available to help out when needed. In line with this, if the report writing team doesn't have capacity to complete a residential report, you are expected to directly help out and complete these reports while at the same time working towards a solution to address this issue (hiring more, building better processes for writing reports, involving AI, etc).



To be considered for this role, you must meet the following criteria:

1. You have extensive work history writing reports for a US residential appraiser. Ideally you have done this for California properties. You must have extensive experience completing the entire report, everything from data entry to sketch to adjustments, 1004MC, selecting comparables, and commentary. If you do not have this experience, we will be unable to consider you for this position.

2. Ideally you have existing management experience, managing other appraisal report writers.



We are flexible with your work hours and offer Philippine daytime shift hours for your convenience. We would like to start part time but then transition to full time, so ideally you are open to working full time exclusively with us if its a mutual fit.



To be considered for this position, you must do the following in your application message (failure to do all of the following will result in your application being ignored):

1. How many years have you worked for a US residential appraiser? What tasks did you perform for them?

2. How many hours does it take you to complete one report? What parts of the report do you complete?

3. Do you have experience writing commentary for the addendum, drawing the sketch, labeling photos, and creating the 1004MC? Please indicate which ones you have experience with, and how many years for each.

4. Please provide a sample of at least one appraisal report you have fully completed. You can redact any private information from the report. Please let me know what parts exactly you completed on this report(s).

5. Provide a publicly accessible link to your resume.

6. Are you open to starting part time and then transitioning to full time? Once working full time with us, will you be working exclusively with us without any other jobs? When is the earliest you can begin working with us?

7. What are your preferred working hours?

8. Do you have experience managing other residential appraisal report writers? If so, please discuss in detail your job responsibilities.

9. Do you have experience in reviewing other residential reports? If so, please discuss in detail your responsibilities.



Thank you, and I look forward to the opportunity to work together.

title: Shopify Store Builder and Product Listing Manager | GMC Approval and Ongoing Catalog Management
description:
**Shopify Store Builder and Product Listing Manager | GMC Approval and Ongoing Catalog Management**



---



We are launching a new ecommerce store and we need someone who can build it the right way from the start. Not just a good looking store but one that is structured correctly to get approved by Google Merchant Center so we can start selling through Google Shopping. Once the store is live and approved the role shifts into ongoing catalog management where you will be adding products and keeping everything accurate and up to date every single day.



This is a long term full time role. The right person will own this store from build to approval to daily operations.



---



**Phase one — Building the store**



You will build our Shopify store from scratch. That means setting up the theme, homepage, collections, navigation, product pages, and all the essential pages like about, contact, refund policy, privacy policy, and terms of service. Everything needs to be clean, mobile friendly, and on brand for a home decor audience.



More importantly everything needs to be structured correctly for Google Merchant Center from day one. That means accurate product titles, descriptions, images, pricing, GTINs, and all required attributes. Shipping and return policies need to meet GMC requirements. The store needs to pass GMC review without issues.



You will also set up the Google Merchant Center account, connect it to Shopify, configure the product feed, and make sure everything syncs correctly and cleanly.



---



**Phase two — Ongoing catalog management**



Once the store is live and GMC approved the role becomes about keeping the catalog growing and accurate. You will be adding new products regularly, updating existing listings, maintaining image quality, and making sure nothing falls out of GMC compliance over time. We expect around 50 products processed within a 2.5 hour window at a consistently high standard.



You will also build out new collection pages and theme sections as the catalog grows, run regular audits to catch errors or disapprovals before they become problems, and keep inventory levels accurate and organized.



---



**What we need from you**



You have built a Shopify store from scratch before and you understand what it takes to get it right the first time. You know Google Merchant Center inside and out. You know what causes disapprovals, how to fix them, and how to structure a store so it passes review cleanly. You are fast and accurate with product listings. Speed without accuracy does not work in this role. You have a strong eye for visual detail. You care about how the store looks and you can tell when something feels off brand. You use AI tools like Gemini and ChatGPT daily to speed up your workflow without sacrificing quality. You can work independently once you understand our standards.



---



**Experience that will move you to the top of the list**



You have successfully gotten a Shopify store approved on Google Merchant Center before. You have managed a large product catalog with hundreds of SKUs. You have experience using Gemini specifically for generating product images that feel consistent and branded rather than generic or stock looking. You have used Kopy or a similar tool for writing and optimizing product listings. Home decor, beauty, health, or lifestyle brand experience is a strong plus.



---



**Tools you should know or be ready to learn fast**



Shopify for store builds and product management. Google Merchant Center for feed setup, compliance, and account management. Gemini for AI product image generation. Kopy or similar for listing copy and optimization. ChatGPT or any AI tool for descriptions and workflow. Canva or Photoshop for image editing and visual cleanup.



---



**How we work**



We will onboard you into our brand standards, product requirements, and what good looks like for us. After that you own the store completely from the technical setup to the daily listing work. We have high standards but we do not micromanage. We expect clean work, consistent output, and clear communication.



---



**How to apply**



Tell us about a Shopify store you built from scratch. If you have gotten a store approved on Google Merchant Center tell us about that specifically — what you set up, what issues came up, and how you resolved them. Share examples of product listings you have created or optimized. Tell us how many products you can list per hour at a high standard. Tell us which AI tools you use and how you use them. If you have used Gemini for product image generation tell us about that.



Generic applications will not be considered. Specific ones with real examples will get a fast response.

title: Paid Ads Manager | Meta and Google | Ecommerce and Short Term Rentals
description:
**Paid Ads Manager | Meta and Google | Ecommerce and Short Term Rentals**



---



We run two businesses. An ecommerce store that sells physical products and a short term rental property business. We need one sharp person who can run paid ads across both. Not someone who has only boosted posts or followed a template. Someone who actually understands how paid traffic works, how funnels work, and how to turn ad spend into real revenue.



Meta is the priority. If you are not strong on Meta do not apply.



---



**What you will be doing**



On the ecommerce side you will be running Meta ads to test and scale winning products. That means building campaigns from scratch, writing ad copy, selecting or editing video creatives, testing angles, monitoring performance daily, cutting what is losing, and scaling what is converting. You will also support Google Shopping campaigns for our Shopify store and make sure our product ads are structured correctly and performing.



On the short term rental side you will be running Meta and Google ads to generate direct bookings for our properties. That means building awareness and retargeting campaigns, driving traffic to landing pages, and optimizing for bookings and inquiries. You will need to understand how to speak to a traveler audience and what makes someone click and book.



Across both businesses you will be responsible for campaign setup, creative testing, budget management, performance reporting, and ongoing optimization. You will also support landing page setup or improvements when needed to make sure the traffic we are paying for actually converts.



---



**What we need from you**



You have run Meta ads for an ecommerce brand before and you can show us results. You understand campaign structure, ad sets, audiences, creative testing, and how to read the numbers. You know what a winning creative looks like and you know how to find or build one. You understand direct response marketing. You are not just running brand awareness. You are running ads that are supposed to make people take action right now. You know how Google Shopping works and you have set up or managed Performance Max or standard Shopping campaigns before. You understand funnels. You know that the ad is only one part of the equation and that the landing page, the offer, and the follow up all matter. You are comfortable setting up or improving landing pages to support your campaigns. You are organized and you report clearly. We need to know what is working, what is not, and what you are doing about it.



---



**Experience that will move you to the top of the list**



You have managed a monthly ad budget of at least five thousand dollars across Meta or Google. You have run ads for both ecommerce and service based businesses before. You have experience with short term rentals, hospitality, travel, or local service businesses. You have used tools like Triple Whale, Northbeam, or any attribution platform. You have built or optimized landing pages using tools like GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels, Unbounce, or similar. You understand creative strategy and can give direction to a video editor or content creator to produce better ad creatives.



---



**Tools you should know**



Meta Business Manager for campaign setup and management. Google Ads for Shopping, Search, and Performance Max campaigns. Google Analytics for traffic and conversion tracking. Any landing page builder — GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels, Unbounce, Shopify pages, or similar. Canva or any basic design tool for simple creative edits. Claude, ChatGPT or any AI tool for copy and research. Spreadsheets for reporting and budget tracking.



---



**How we work**



This is a full time role. You will manage ad accounts across both businesses and report directly to the owner. We expect clear communication, proactive updates, and a mindset focused on results not just activity. We do not want someone who runs ads and waits to be told what to fix. We want someone who sees a problem and fixes it before we even notice it.



---



**How to apply**



Show us real results. Tell us about a Meta campaign you ran for an ecommerce brand. What was the product, what was the ad spend, what was the return, and what did you do to get there. Tell us about any experience running ads for service businesses, hospitality, or bookings. Share any landing pages you have built or improved. Tell us your monthly ad spend experience. Tell us which tools you use and why.



If your application does not include real numbers and real examples we will not respond. If it does we will get back to you fast.

description:
**Ecommerce Growth Operator | Supplement Brand | TikTok Research and Meta Ads**



---



We are building a supplement brand from the ground up. The model is simple. We find supplement products that are already proven on TikTok Shop, private label our own version, build a Shopify store around it, and scale it with Meta ads. We move fast, we test fast, and we double down on what works.



We are not looking for someone to manage tasks. We are looking for someone who understands this model, has done something like it before, and can take a product from research to live store to running ads without needing their hand held every step of the way.



---



**What this role actually looks like**



You will spend time researching supplement products that are already selling well on TikTok Shop. You are looking for products with strong demand signals, real social proof, good margins, and room to compete with a private label version. Once you identify a winner you will help us source a private label version, work with our supplier to get it produced or fulfilled, and build a Shopify store around it that is clean, trustworthy, and built to convert.



Then you launch Meta ads. You find the best performing videos for that product or category, make them better, write the copy, set up the campaigns, and monitor performance daily. You cut what is not working and push harder on what is converting. You understand that in the supplement space trust and credibility are everything so the store, the ads, and the messaging all need to feel legitimate and professional.



You will also handle supplier communication, verify orders, coordinate fulfillment, and keep operations organized as we scale.



---



**The supplement space has specific requirements and you need to understand them**



Supplement ads on Meta have strict rules. You cannot make certain health claims. You cannot use before and after imagery in certain ways. You need to know what gets ads disapproved and how to write copy that converts without triggering a policy violation. If you have never run supplement ads before this is not the role for you. If you have and you know how to navigate the compliance side while still writing ads that sell this is exactly the role for you.



The same applies to the store. A supplement store needs to feel credible. That means professional product photography or AI generated imagery that looks real, clear ingredient information, trust signals like reviews and guarantees, and copy that speaks to real customer concerns without making illegal claims.



---



**Who we are looking for**



You have researched winning products on TikTok Shop before and you can walk us through your process. You have run Meta ads for a physical product brand and you have real numbers to show for it. You understand the supplement space well enough to know what sells, what claims are allowed, and how to position a private label product against established brands. You can build a Shopify store from scratch in under 8 hours. You are comfortable sourcing private label products and communicating with suppliers. You use AI tools every day to speed up research, copy, and creative production. You work independently and you are focused on results not just completing tasks.



---



**You are not the right fit if**



You have never run a paid ad campaign from scratch. You do not understand supplement compliance on Meta. You need a team around you to do product research. You cannot show us proof of something you tested and what happened. You are looking for a slow paced admin role.



---



**Experience that will move you to the top of the list**



You have run Meta ads specifically for a supplement or health and wellness brand. You have private labeled a product before and understand the sourcing and fulfillment process. You have used Kalodata or a similar tool for TikTok product research. You have experience with supplement compliance on Meta and know how to write copy that converts without violating policies. You have built a Shopify store for a health or wellness brand that felt credible and professional.



---



**Tools you should know**



Kalodata for TikTok product research and validation. Shopify for store builds and product management. Meta Business Manager for campaign setup and management. title: AU Asset Finance
description:
Asset Finance Support

Remote / Work from Home |AEST Hours | Supporting Australian Asset Finance Brokers



Who We're Looking For

We're building a dedicated team of asset finance support professionals to work directly with Australian asset finance brokers. If you have hands-on experience processing equipment, vehicle, or commercial asset finance applications and understand the end-to-end broker workflow, we want to hear from you.



To Apply, please submit this form:  



What You'll Be Doing Every Day



Managing asset finance files end-to-end — from initial client enquiry through to settlement and post-settlement

Data entry and file management in broker CRM platforms (Mercury, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Preparing and submitting finance applications to lenders via broker portals

Ordering and tracking asset valuations and credit assessments

Requesting and tracking pricing and rate concessions from lenders

Running asset finance calculators — balloon payments, residual values, comparison rates, repayment schedules

Preparing compliance documents, credit diary notes, settlement letters, and payout figures

Ordering and interpreting commercial credit reports (e.g. Equifax, CreditorWatch, Veda)

Coordinating with lenders, vendors, dealers, and clients throughout the approval and settlement process

Managing discharge and payout requests, PPSR checks, and ASIC searches

Preparing funds-to-complete confirmations and settlement instructions

Post-settlement tasks — invoice reconciliation, asset registration follow-up, client retention





You Must Have

2–3 years of experience in Australian asset finance — broker-side, not lender operations

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

 Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Excellent written and spoken English — direct communication with brokers, clients, and lenders



Minimum Requirements



Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have



Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Exposure to construction equipment, yellow goods, or specialised asset classes

Familiarity with commercial property-backed asset finance

Experience using ApplyOnline, Loanapp, or Simpology for commercial submissions

Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking or equivalent





Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer



Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

## About the Role



Peptide Performance Coaching is a growing health and performance community (70+ active members) built around peptide education, body recomposition, and coaching under 
 brand. We’re hiring two Virtual Assistants to help run day-to-day content and engagement inside our Skool community.



This is a low base-pay, high-upside role. The real money is in commission — every product sale you help generate earns you $5. Members already buy these products elsewhere; your job is part of helping them buy through us instead. VAs who are sharp, consistent, and good at building relationships in the community can grow this into serious income over time. We’re looking for people who want to grow with us, not just clock hours.



## What You’ll Be Doing



- Creating 2 graphic posts per day for the Skool community (educational content — peptide info, tips, brand-consistent visuals)

- Posting 3 polls per day designed to spark engagement and conversation

- Messaging at least 3 members per day to build relationships, answer questions, and guide them toward our products

- Responding to member questions and comments across the community

- Communicating regularly with me on priorities, content direction, and member feedback

- Helping keep the community active, engaged, and informed



## What We’re Looking For



- Comfortable using AI tools to speed up content creation (e.g., Canva AI, ChatGPT for captions/copy, image generation tools) — you don’t need to be a designer, but you need to move fast and produce clean, on-brand work

- Strong written communication — clear, friendly, professional English

- Self-starter who can manage daily tasks without heavy oversight

- Comfortable with sales conversations — this role involves real selling, not just posting

- Reliable and consistent — daily tasks need to happen daily, not in batches

- Bonus: experience with Skool, health/fitness content, or wellness/supplement spaces



## Pay Structure



- **Base pay:** $2.50/hour, paid weekly

- **Commission:** $5 per product sold that you can be credited with generating (through your outreach, content, or conversations)

- Your income is built primarily through commission — the base pay covers your time on daily tasks, but your earning potential is tied to how well you drive engagement and sales

- Top performers will have opportunities for increased base pay, more responsibility, and higher commission tiers as the community and brand grow



## Growth Path



This is a **starter position** — it’s the entry point into the brand, not the ceiling. As the community and sales grow, I’ll be promoting one person into a **Manager role** overseeing bigger responsibilities: website management, social media sales strategy, and leading other VAs/tea
mbers.



VAs who are consistent, sharp, and good at driving engagement and sales have real potential to earn over $1,000/month as commission scales — this isn’t capped, and it isn’t guaranteed; it’s tied directly to your performance and the community’s growth. The harder and smarter you work this, the more you make and the faster you move up.



## What We Provide



- Brand logo, color palette, and content templates already built

- Product information, pricing, and talking points

- Direct access to me for questions, training, and feedback



## How to Apply



Reply to this job post with:



1. A short intro (who you are, your experience with content/social/community management)

1. Examples of past graphic or social content you’ve created (if available)

1. Your availability (days/hours you can commit to)

1. Why this kind of commission-based growth role interests you



We’re moving quickly to fill these two spots — apply soon.
