title: Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing and Supplier Operations Specialist
description:
Position: Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist

Type: Full-Time, Remote (Philippines)

Salary: PHP 25,000 - 45,000 / month, depending on experience

Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours, with flexibility for supplier, distributor, and Amazon-related communication



About our Company



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade, wholesale, and e-commerce. We are building Amazon wholesale and private label operations in Canada and the United States, with a focus on long-term supplier relationships, organized execution, and data-driven decision-making. Our company values professionalism, clear communication, and practical execution. We are establishing a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.



Role Overview



We are seeking an Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Research, Sourcing & Supplier Operations Specialist to execute and manage key parts of our Amazon wholesale workflow across Canada and the United States. This role combines Amazon wholesale product research, supplier sourcing, distributor and brand outreach, account applications, onboarding, follow-ups, and daily workflow execution.



This is a main execution role, not a passive support role. The main purpose is to find and validate viable Amazon wholesale opportunities, build and manage the supplier pipeline, keep supplier and product files organized, and move the workflow forward without constant supervision.

The exact focus may shift depending on business priorities, supplier responses, available catalogs, and current workflow bottlenecks.



NOTE: General VA, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, customer service, or basic admin experience alone is not suitable for this role. Candidates must have direct Amazon product research, Amazon wholesale, supplier sourcing, supplier communication, or Amazon operations experience.



Key Responsibilities:



• Conduct Amazon wholesale product research using Amazon, Keepa, SellerAmp, Seller Central, Google Sheets, and other available Amazon research tools.

• Evaluate product demand, pricing, Buy Box behavior, FBA competition, seller count, Amazon presence, reviews, sales rank, gating status, brand restrictions, and estimated profitability.

• Screen supplier catalogs, wholesale price lists, brand search results, distributor product lists, and product files to identify viable Amazon wholesale opportunities.

• Research and identify potential wholesale distributors, brands, manufacturers, and suppliers in Canada and the United States.

• Contact suppliers, distributors, and brands by
 or web form and follow up professionally.

• Complete wholesale account applications, supplier forms, distributor onboarding forms, and account setup documents.

• Request and organize wholesale pricing, catalogs, MOQ, case pack details, stock availability, lead times, shipping terms, payment terms, and account requirements.

• Confirm whether suppliers allow Amazon, FBA, online marketplace sales, reseller accounts, or require written marketplace approval.

• Maintain supplier trackers, distributor trackers, application status sheets, outreach logs, product screening files, and follow-up lists.

• Organize supplier folders, application screenshots, pricing lists, catalog files, account notes, product research notes, and communication records in Google Drive.

• Coordinate with prep centers, suppliers, distributors, and internal tea
mbers when needed.

• Use AI tools to draft, organize, summarize, and check work, while carefully verifying accuracy.

• Prepare clear daily updates showing completed work, links, blockers, risks, and next steps.

• Flag supplier issues, application blockers, missing documents, marketplace restrictions, pricing problems, weak products, poor-fit suppliers, or workflow delays early.

• Support both Amazon Canada and Amazon US wholesale workflows as the business expands.



Qualifications:



• 2-4 years of direct Amazon FBA wholesale experience required, including Amazon product research, wholesale product screening, supplier sourcing, distributor outreach, brand outreach, Amazon operations, and wholesale account setup.

• Hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, Keepa, SellerAmp, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Gmail, supplier catalogs, wholesale price lists, and distributor application workflows required.

• Strong understanding of wholesale product viability, including demand, pricing, competition, Buy Box, seller count, Amazon presence, fees, profitability, gating, and brand restrictions.

• Strong written English and professional supplier communication skills.

• Highly organized and able to manage multiple product research tasks, supplier conversations, applications, files, follow-ups, and status trackers at the same time.

• Comfortable following SOPs, checklists, templates, company instructions, policies, and structured workflows.

• Strong attention to detail with product data, pricing, supplier information, application forms, account requirements, and status tracking.

• Able to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and keep work moving without constant supervision.

• Comfortable asking clear questions, reporting blockers early, and providing practical updates.

• Must be comfortable with both Amazon product research and supplier-side communication, not only one side of the workflow.

• Must be reliable, responsive, and consistent with daily execution.

• Must be up-to-date with AI tools and actively use them to improve research quality, analysis, judgment, decision-making, and workflow speed.



KPIs / Success Measures:



• Quality and accuracy of Amazon wholesale product research and screening decisions.

• Ability to identify viable wholesale opportunities and reject weak products or poor-fit suppliers quickly.

• Number and quality of relevant suppliers, distributors, brands, catalogs, and product opportunities researched.

• Quality and consistency of supplier, distributor, and brand outreach.

• Accuracy and completeness of wholesale applications, onboarding files, supplier records, and product research files.

• Speed and quality of follow-ups without losing professionalism or accuracy.

• Organization of Google Drive folders, trackers, supplier records, product screening files, and daily work files.

• Ability to identify supplier restrictions, Amazon marketplace issues, gating issues, application blockers, pricing issues, and workflow risks early.

• Low error rate in forms, supplier details, pricing data, product information, and tracking sheets.

• Clear communication of completed work, blockers, risks, action items, and next steps.

• Ability to take ownership of the wholesale workflow and improve execution over time.

• Consistent ability to follow company instructions, SOPs, policies, and communication standards.



What We Offer:



• Full-time remote/hybrid work opportunity with a Canadian company.

• Long-term opportunity as the Amazon wholesale business grows.

• Structured SOPs, templates, and workflow support.

• Direct communication with company management.

• Opportunity to work across Amazon product research, wholesale sourcing, supplier operations, and marketplace expansion.

• Opportunity to grow into a more senior role as the business reaches revenue and expands.

• Performance-based growth opportunities.

title: Social Media Strategist / Creative Manager
description:
We are hiring a highly creative Social Media Strategist / Creative Manager to help lead the social direction for two growing consumer brands.



This is not a 'schedule posts and manage a content calendar' role.



We are looking for someone who deeply understands modern social media, brand voice, content strategy, creative direction, and what actually makes people stop scrolling, engage, trust, and buy.



You will help shape the social media strategy for two different brands with two different audiences:



* Bamboo Ave, a men's travel and lifestyle apparel brand

* Avori, a women's beauty, style, and AI-powered transformation brand



The right person is creative, proactive, strategic, and obsessed with making content work. We want someone who can look at a brand, understand the customer, study what is working online, and come back with clear ideas, not someone who waits to be told exactly what to post.



What You Will Own

* Social media strategy across Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms

* Brand voice and content direction

* Weekly content ideas and creative concepts

* Feed planning and content organization

* Posting, scheduling, captions, and community awareness

* Identifying trends and turning them into brand-relevant content

* Working with our graphic designer and team to bring ideas to life

* Reviewing performance and improving based on what is working

* Helping build separate strategies for two very different brands and audiences



What We Are Looking For

You might be a great fit if you:

* Understand social media beyond basic posting

* Have strong creative taste

* Can think strategically about content, brand, and audience

* Know how to build a content plan that drives impact

* Can show examples of feeds or accounts you have helped manage

* Are proactive and do not need to be micromanaged

* Care deeply about doing great work

* Can spot what is working on social and explain why

* Can write strong captions and hooks

* Have basic editing, design, or creative production skills, which is a big plus

* Are comfortable working across two different brands with different customers



We are looking for an A-player. Someone with taste, ownership, speed, work ethic, and creativity.



This Role Is Not For You If

* You only want to schedule posts

* You need every idea handed to you

* You do not study trends, creators, brands, and social platforms

* You cannot explain your creative decisions

* You are not comfortable owning strategy

* You are not proactive



How To Apply

Please
 me at 
 with the subject line:

Social Media Strategist Application



In your
, include:

1. Your resume or short background

2. Links to social media accounts or feeds you have been responsible for

3. A Loom video under 5 minutes answering the questions below



Loom Video Questions

Please keep your Loom under 5 minutes and answer these questions:

1. What social media accounts or feeds have you personally been responsible for?

Please share the links and explain what your role was.



2. Walk us through one account you helped grow or improve.

What was the strategy, what did you change, and what happened?



3. How do you come up with a social media strategy for a brand?

What do you look at first? Audience, competitors, trends, product, content gaps, brand voice, platform behavior, etc.



4. Pick either Bamboo Ave or Avori and give us 3 content ideas you would test first.

Briefly explain why you would test those ideas.



5. Show us your creativity.

What is one social media trend, format, or creative angle you think more brands should be using right now, and how would you adapt it for a brand?



6. Tell us about your work style.

How do you stay proactive, organized, and focused on impact without needing someone to tell you every next step?



7. Bonus: Can you personally create or edit content?

If yes, please share examples of videos, graphics, reels, TikToks, or posts you created yourself.

title: Editing Interior photos
description:
Hello,



I would love for you to edit these images as a test so we can see if we share the same style and vision before potentially working together on a long-term basis.



The most important thing for me is that the images look natural and authentic. I shoot using natural light, and I want to preserve that feeling in the final result. The images should not look over-edited, overly bright, or as if they were lit with flash.



These images are for a Christmas campaign, so I would like a warm, cozy, atmospheric winter feeling. I prefer a mood that is slightly darker and more cinematic rather than bright and airy, while still looking crisp, clean, and professional. Think Christmas, winter, hygge, warmth, elegance, and a premium feel.



In particular, I would like:

- Natural and tasteful enhancement of colors.

- Beautiful and natural retouching of the model without looking retouched.

- Natural-looking skin tones and facial features.

- A harmonious and polished overall look.

- Realistic snow and winter atmosphere outside the windows.

- The outdoor winter scenery can be slightly soft or diffused rather than very sharp, so the focus remains on the interior and overall mood.

- Removal of visible cables, wires, and other distracting elements when appropriate.

- Removal of distracting reflections or other details that take attention away from the image.

- A clean, refined, and visually pleasing result while maintaining realism.



What matters most to me is the overall feeling and atmosphere of the image. I want the final result to feel genuine, premium, inviting, and believable—not artificial or heavily edited.

 and Instagram ads

title: Go High Level Admin
description:
## About Us



We are a plaintiff-side law firm that takes on insurance companies for a living. When carriers lowball, delay, and deny, we make them pay what they owe our clients. We have scaled fast, we run on technology, and our mascot is a standard poodle named Skrt. Our promise is simple: Sit. Stay. Settle.



Behind every signed client is a lead that got answered fast, nurtured well, and routed to the right person at the right 
nt. That entire engine runs on GoHighLevel, and we are looking for the person who will own it.



## The Role



As our GoHighLevel Administrator, you own our intake and marketing engine end to end. You will design, build, and maintain the automations, pipelines, forms, and campaigns that turn marketing spend into signed cases. You are equal parts systems builder, troubleshooter, and conversion optimizer, and you care deeply about speed-to-lead and clean data. If you see a broken workflow, you fix it before it costs us a case. If you see a faster path from lead to signature, you build it.



## What You Will Own



- Administer the firm's GoHighLevel account and sub-accounts, including users, permissions, roles, and overall system health

- Design, build, test, and maintain automation workflows across the full intake journey, including new-lead response, missed-call text-back, nurture sequences, appointment reminders, and post-sign follow-up

- Configure and continuously optimize pipelines and stages so they mirror our real lead-to-signed-client process

- Build and maintain intake forms, surveys, funnels, calendars, and landing pages

- Own lead routing and assignment logic, including round-robin distribution and real-time notifications to intake staff

- Manage SMS and
 communications, including templates, deliverability, and compliance with A2P 10DLC registration and TCPA requirements

- Maintain and improve our review and reputation request workflows

- Integrate GoHighLevel with our other systems using native integrations, webhooks, and APIs

- Build dashboards and reporting on lead source, conversion rate, speed-to-lead, and intake-team performance

- Keep data clean, monitor automations for breakage, and resolve issues quickly

- Document GoHighLevel processes as written SOPs and train intake staff on day-to-day use

- Stay current on new GoHighLevel features and bring us ideas worth implementing



## What We Are Looking For



- hands-on GoHighLevel administration, building and configuring rather than just using it

- Deep understanding of CRM structure, sales pipelines, and marketing automation

- A proven track record building multi-step workflows and automations that actually run reliably

- Working knowledge of A2P 10DLC registration and SMS and
 compliance

- Comfort with webhooks, APIs, and third-party integrations

- Strong reporting instincts and a real commitment to data hygiene

- Self-directed, detail-obsessed, and able to translate a business goal into a working system



## Bonus Points



- Experience in a law firm, legal intake operation, or another high-volume lead environment

- Experience migrating from another intake CRM (Lead Docket experience is a plus)

- Familiarity with multi-state or multi-location pipeline setups

- An eye for conversion when building landing pages and funnels

- A genuine dislike of insurance companies
